_legend: Short vowels: a e i o u (u as in "put"). Long vowels: ah ay ee oh oo (pure, held longer; "ay" with no glide). ew = Latin eu as one syllable (e+oo). CAPS = stressed syllable. w = Latin v; k = c (always hard); g always hard; gn sounds like ngn (magnus = MANG-nus; at the start of a word it is g+n); p/t/k after an aspirated ph/th/ch are breathy p/t/k, NOT f/th. z = dz (Allen; some sources give a long z between vowels).

r-vulg-john-1-5.latin: In prīncipiō erat Verbum, et Verbum erat apud Deum, et Deus erat Verbum. Hoc erat in prīncipiō apud Deum. Omnia per ipsum facta sunt, et sine ipsō factum est nihil quod factum est. In ipsō vīta erat, et vīta erat lūx hominum. Et lūx in tenebrīs lūcet, et tenebrae eam nōn conprehendērunt.

r-vulg-genesis-1-5.ipa: /ɪn priːŋ.ˈkɪ.pɪ.oː krɛ.ˈaː.wɪt ˈdɛ.ʊs ˈkae̯.lʊm ɛt ˈtɛr.ram ˈtɛr.ra ˈau̯.tɛm ˈɛ.rat ɪ.ˈnaː.nɪs ɛt ˈwa.kʊ.a ɛt ˈtɛ.nɛ.brae̯ ˈɛ.rant ˈsʊ.pɛr ˈfa.kɪ.ɛm a.ˈbʏs.siː ɛt ˈspiː.rɪ.tʊs ˈdɛ.iː fɛ.reː.ˈbaː.tʊr ˈsʊ.pɛr ˈa.kʷaːs diːk.ˈsɪt.kʷɛ ˈdɛ.ʊs ˈfiː.at luːks ɛt ˈfak.ta ɛst luːks ɛt ˈwiː.dɪt ˈdɛ.ʊs ˈluː.kɛm kʷɔd ˈɛs.sɛt ˈbɔ.na ɛt diː.ˈwiː.sɪt ˈluː.kɛm aː ˈtɛ.nɛ.briːs ap.pɛl.laː.ˈwɪt.kʷɛ ˈluː.kɛm ˈdɪ.ɛm ɛt ˈtɛ.nɛ.braːs ˈnɔk.tɛm fak.ˈtʊm.kʷɛ ɛst ˈwɛs.pɛ.rɛ ɛt ˈmaː.nɛ ˈdɪ.eːs ˈuː.nʊs/

r-vulg-genesis-1-5.latin: In prīncipiō creāvit Deus caelum et terram. Terra autem erat inānis et vacua, et tenebrae erant super faciem abyssī, et spīritus Deī ferēbātur super aquās. Dīxitque Deus: “Fīat lūx.” Et facta est lūx. Et vīdit Deus lūcem quod esset bona, et dīvīsit lūcem ā tenebrīs. Appellāvitque lūcem Diem, et tenebrās Noctem; factumque est vespere et māne, diēs ūnus.

q-augustine-regna.respelling: re-MOH-tah I-ta-kwe yoos-TI-ti-ah kwid sunt RAYNG-na NI-si MANG-na la-troh-KI-ni-a
q-augustine-regna.latin: Remōtā itaque iūstitiā quid sunt rēgna nisi magna latrōcinia?

q-virgil-felix.respelling: FAY-leeks kwee PO-tu-it RAY-rum kong-NOHS-ke-re KOW-sahs
q-virgil-felix.respelling_verse: FAY-leeks kwee PO-tu-it RAY-roon kong-NOHS-ke-re KOW-sahs
q-virgil-felix.latin: Fēlīx quī potuit rērum cognōscere causās.

q-bernard-nanos.ipa: /diː.ˈkeː.bat bɛr.ˈnar.dʊs kar.nɔ.ˈteːn.sɪs noːs ˈɛs.sɛ ˈkʷa.sɪ ˈnaː.noːs gɪ.ˈgan.tʊm ˈʊ.mɛ.riːs iːn.sɪ.ˈdɛn.teːs/
q-bernard-nanos.respelling: dee-KAY-bat ber-NAR-dus kar-no-TAYN-sis nohs ES-se KWA-si NAH-nohs gi-GAN-tum U-me-rees een-si-DEN-tays
q-bernard-nanos.latin: Dīcēbat Bernardus Carnotēnsis nōs esse quasi nānōs, gigantum umerīs īnsidentēs.

q-vegetius-pacem.respelling: I-gi-tur kwee day-SEE-de-rat PAH-kem PREYE-pa-ret BEL-lum
q-vegetius-pacem.latin: Igitur quī dēsīderat pācem, praeparet bellum.

q-caesar-garumna.ipa: /ˈgal.loːs ab a.kʷiː.ˈtaː.niːs ga.ˈrʊm.na ˈfluː.mɛn aː ˈbɛl.giːs ˈma.trɔ.na ɛt ˈseː.kʷa.na ˈdiː.wɪ.dɪt/
q-caesar-garumna.respelling: GAL-lohs ab a-kwee-TAH-nees ga-RUM-na FLOO-men ah BEL-gees MA-tro-na et SAY-kwa-na DEE-wi-dit
q-caesar-garumna.latin: Gallōs ab Aquītānīs Garumna flūmen, ā Belgīs Matrona et Sēquana dīvidit.

q-caesar-castra-movent.ipa: /ˈpɔs.tɛ.roː ˈdɪ.eː ˈkas.tra ɛks ˈɛ.oː ˈlɔ.koː ˈmɔ.wɛnt/
q-caesar-castra-movent.respelling: POS-te-roh DI-ay KAS-tra eks E-oh LO-koh MO-went
q-caesar-castra-movent.latin: Posterō diē castra ex eō locō movent.

q-seneca-si-vales.respelling: see WA-lays BE-ne est E-go WA-le-oh
q-seneca-si-vales.latin: Sī valēs, bene est; ego valeō.

v-milites-aedificant.respelling: MEE-li-tays AR-bo-rays KEYE-dunt et KAS-tra eye-DI-fi-kant
v-milites-aedificant.latin: Mīlitēs arborēs caedunt et castra aedificant.

q-martial-thais.ipa: /ˈtʰaː.ɪs ˈha.bɛt ˈnɪ.groːs ˈnɪ.wɛ.oːs lae̯.ˈka.nɪ.a ˈdɛn.teːs kʷae̯ ˈra.tɪ.oː ɛst ˈeːmp.toːs hae̯k ˈha.bɛt ˈɪl.la ˈsʊ.oːs/
q-martial-thais.respelling: TAH-is HA-bet NI-grohs NI-we-ohs leye-KA-ni-a DEN-tays kweye RA-ti-oh est AYMP-tohs heyek HA-bet IL-la SU-ohs
q-martial-thais.ipa_verse: /ˈtʰaː.ɪs ˈha.bɛt ˈnɪ.groːs ˈnɪ.wɛ.oːs lae̯.ˈka.nɪ.a ˈdɛn.teːs kʷae̯ ˈra.tɪ.oː‿st ˈeːmp.toːs hae̯k ˈha.bɛt ˈɪl.la ˈsʊ.oːs/
q-martial-thais.respelling_verse: TAH-is HA-bet NI-grohs NI-we-ohs leye-KA-ni-a DEN-tays kweye RA-ti-oh'st AYMP-tohs heyek HA-bet IL-la SU-ohs
q-martial-thais.latin: Thāis habet nigrōs, niveōs Laecania dentēs. Quae ratiō est? Ēmptōs haec habet, illa suōs.

q-juvenal-rara-avis.ipa: /ˈraː.ra ˈa.wɪs ɪn ˈtɛr.riːs nɪ.ˈgroː.kʷɛ sɪ.ˈmɪl.lɪ.ma ˈkʏk.noː/
q-juvenal-rara-avis.respelling: RAH-ra A-wis in TER-rees ni-GROH-kwe si-MIL-li-ma KÜK-noh
q-juvenal-rara-avis.latin: Rāra avis in terrīs nigrōque simillima cycnō

q-tacitus-reges.ipa: /ˈreː.geːs ɛks noː.bɪ.lɪ.ˈtaː.tɛ ˈdʊ.keːs ɛks wɪr.ˈtuː.tɛ ˈsuː.mʊnt/
q-tacitus-reges.respelling: RAY-gays eks noh-bi-li-TAH-te DU-kays eks wir-TOO-te SOO-munt
q-tacitus-reges.latin: Rēgēs ex nōbilitāte, ducēs ex virtūte sūmunt.

q-horace-ibam.ipa: /ˈiː.bam ˈfɔr.tɛ ˈwɪ.aː ˈsa.kraː ˈsiː.kʊt ˈmɛ.ʊs ɛst moːs/
q-horace-ibam.respelling: EE-bam FOR-te WI-ah SA-krah SEE-kut ME-us est mohs
q-horace-ibam.ipa_verse: /ˈiː.bãː ˈfɔr.tɛ ˈwɪ.aː ˈsa.kraː ˈsiː.kʊt ˈmɛ.ʊs ɛst moːs/
q-horace-ibam.respelling_verse: EE-bahn FOR-te WI-ah SA-krah SEE-kut ME-us est mohs
q-horace-ibam.latin: Ībam forte viā Sacrā, sīcut meus est mōs

q-martial-diaulus.ipa: /ˈnuː.pɛr ˈɛ.rat ˈmɛ.dɪ.kʊs nʊŋk ɛst wɪs.ˈpɪl.loː dɪ.ˈau̯.lʊs kʷɔd wɪs.ˈpɪl.loː ˈfa.kɪt ˈfeː.kɛ.rat ɛt ˈmɛ.dɪ.kʊs/
q-martial-diaulus.respelling: NOO-per E-rat ME-di-kus nungk est wis-PIL-loh di-OW-lus kwod wis-PIL-loh FA-kit FAY-ke-rat et ME-di-kus
q-martial-diaulus.latin: Nūper erat medicus, nunc est vispillō Diaulus: quod vispillō facit, fēcerat et medicus.

q-resgestae-bis-ovans.ipa: /bɪs ˈɔ.waːns trɪ.ʊm.ˈpʰaː.wiː triːs ˈeː.giː kʊ.ˈruː.liːs trɪ.ˈʊm.pʰoːs/
q-resgestae-bis-ovans.respelling: bis O-wahns tri-um-PAH-wee trees AY-gee ku-ROO-lees tri-UM-pohs
q-resgestae-bis-ovans.latin: Bis ovāns triumphāvī, trīs ēgī curūlīs triumphōs.

q-pliny-misenum.respelling: E-rat mee-SAY-nee klas-SEM-kwe im-PE-ri-oh PREYE-sayns re-GAY-bat
q-pliny-misenum.latin: Erat Mīsēnī classemque imperiō praesēns regēbat.

q-martial-pauper.ipa: /ˈsɛm.pɛr ˈpau̯.pɛr ˈɛ.rɪs siː ˈpau̯.pɛr ɛs ae̯.mɪ.lɪ.ˈaː.nɛ ˈdan.tʊr ˈɔ.peːs ˈnuːl.liːs nʊŋk ˈnɪ.sɪ diː.ˈwɪ.tɪ.bʊs/
q-martial-pauper.respelling: SEM-per POW-per E-ris see POW-per es eye-mi-li-AH-ne DAN-tur O-pays NOOL-lees nungk NI-si dee-WI-ti-bus
q-martial-pauper.latin: Semper pauper eris, sī pauper es, Aemiliāne: dantur opēs nūllīs nunc nisi dīvitibus.

q-seneca-naturam.respelling: proh-PO-si-tum NOS-trum est se-KUN-dum nah-TOO-ram WEE-we-re
q-seneca-naturam.latin: Prōpositum nostrum est secundum nātūram vīvere.

q-seneca-brevitas.ipa: /noːn ɛk.ˈsɪ.gʊ.ʊm ˈtɛm.pɔ.rɪs ha.ˈbeː.mʊs sɛd ˈmʊl.tʊm pɛr.ˈdɪ.dɪ.mʊs/
q-seneca-brevitas.respelling: nohn ek-SI-gu-um TEM-po-ris ha-BAY-mus sed MUL-tum per-DI-di-mus
q-seneca-brevitas.latin: Nōn exiguum temporis habēmus, sed multum perdidimus.

q-lucretius-mors.ipa: /niːl ˈɪ.gɪ.tʊr mɔrs ɛst ad noːs ˈnɛ.kʷɛ ˈpɛr.tɪ.nɛt ˈhiː.lʊm/
q-lucretius-mors.respelling: neel I-gi-tur mors est ad nohs NE-kwe PER-ti-net HEE-lum
q-lucretius-mors.ipa_verse: /niːl ˈɪ.gɪ.tʊr mɔrs ɛst ad noːs ˈnɛ.kʷɛ ˈpɛr.tɪ.nɛt ˈhiː.lũː/
q-lucretius-mors.respelling_verse: neel I-gi-tur mors est ad nohs NE-kwe PER-ti-net HEE-loon
q-lucretius-mors.latin: Nīl igitur mors est ad nōs neque pertinet hīlum.

q-cicero-socrates-caelo.ipa: /ˈsoː.kra.teːs ˈau̯.tɛm ˈpriː.mʊs pʰɪ.lɔ.ˈsɔ.pʰɪ.am deː.wɔ.ˈkaː.wɪt eː ˈkae̯.loː ɛt ɪn ˈʊr.bɪ.bʊs kɔn.lɔ.ˈkaː.wɪt/
q-cicero-socrates-caelo.respelling: SOH-kra-tays OW-tem PREE-mus pi-lo-SO-pi-am day-wo-KAH-wit ay KEYE-loh et in UR-bi-bus kon-lo-KAH-wit
q-cicero-socrates-caelo.latin: Sōcratēs autem prīmus philosophiam dēvocāvit ē caelō et in urbibus conlocāvit.

q-cicero-commentatio.ipa: /ˈtoː.ta ˈɛ.nɪm pʰɪ.lɔ.sɔ.ˈpʰoː.rʊm ˈwiː.ta ʊt ˈa.ɪt ˈɪ.dɛm kɔm.mɛn.ˈtaː.tɪ.oː ˈmɔr.tɪs ɛst/
q-cicero-commentatio.respelling: TOH-ta E-nim pi-lo-so-POH-rum WEE-ta ut A-it I-dem kom-men-TAH-ti-oh MOR-tis est
q-cicero-commentatio.latin: Tōta enim philosophōrum vīta, ut ait idem, commentātiō mortis est.

q-tertullian-semen.ipa: /ˈpluː.reːs ɛf.ˈfɪ.kɪ.mʊr ˈkʷɔ.tɪ.eːns ˈmɛ.tɪ.mʊr aː ˈwoː.biːs ˈseː.mɛn ɛst ˈsaŋ.gʷɪs kʰriːs.tɪ.aː.ˈnoː.rʊm/
q-tertullian-semen.respelling: PLOO-rays ef-FI-ki-mur KWO-ti-ayns ME-ti-mur ah WOH-bees SAY-men est SANG-gwis krees-ti-ah-NOH-rum
q-tertullian-semen.latin: Plūrēs efficimur, quotiēns metimur ā vōbīs: sēmen est sanguis Chrīstiānōrum.

q-tertullian-athenis.ipa: /kʷɪd ˈɛr.goː a.ˈtʰeː.niːs ɛt hɪ.ɛ.rɔ.ˈsɔ.lʏ.miːs kʷɪd a.ka.ˈdeː.mɪ.ae̯ ɛt ɛk.ˈkleː.sɪ.ae̯/
q-tertullian-athenis.respelling: kwid ER-goh a-TAY-nees et hi-e-ro-SO-lü-mees kwid a-ka-DAY-mi-eye et ek-KLAY-si-eye
q-tertullian-athenis.latin: Quid ergō Athēnīs et Hierosolymīs? Quid acadēmiae et ecclēsiae?

q-perpetua-christiana.ipa: /hɪ.la.rɪ.ˈaː.nʊs kʰriːs.tɪ.ˈaː.na ɛs ˈɪŋ.kʷɪt ɛt ˈɛ.gɔ rɛs.ˈpɔn.diː kʰriːs.tɪ.ˈaː.na sʊm/
q-perpetua-christiana.respelling: hi-la-ri-AH-nus krees-ti-AH-na es ING-kwit et E-go res-PON-dee krees-ti-AH-na sum
q-perpetua-christiana.latin: Hilariānus: "Chrīstiāna es?" inquit. Et ego respondī: "Chrīstiāna sum."

q-augustine-carthago.ipa: /ˈweː.niː kar.ˈtʰaː.gɪ.nɛm ɛt kɪr.kʊms.trɛ.ˈpeː.bat meː ˈʊn.dɪ.kʷɛ sar.ˈtaː.goː flaː.gɪ.tɪ.oː.ˈsoː.rʊm a.ˈmoː.rʊm/
q-augustine-carthago.respelling: WAY-nee kar-TAH-gi-nem et kir-kums-tre-PAY-bat may UN-di-kwe sar-TAH-goh flah-gi-ti-oh-SOH-rum a-MOH-rum
q-augustine-carthago.latin: Vēnī Carthāginem, et circumstrepēbat mē undique sartāgō flāgitiōsōrum amōrum.

q-boethius-infortunii.ipa: /ɪn ˈɔm.niː ad.wɛr.sɪ.ˈtaː.tɛ fɔr.ˈtuː.nae̯ iːn.feː.liː.ˈkɪs.sɪ.mʊm ɛst ˈgɛ.nʊs iːn.fɔr.ˈtuː.nɪ.iː fʊ.ˈɪs.sɛ feː.ˈliː.kɛm/
q-boethius-infortunii.respelling: in OM-nee ad-wer-si-TAH-te for-TOO-neye een-fay-lee-KIS-si-mum est GE-nus een-for-TOO-ni-ee fu-IS-se fay-LEE-kem
q-boethius-infortunii.latin: In omnī adversitāte fortūnae īnfēlīcissimum est genus īnfortūniī fuisse fēlīcem.

q-vulg-verbum-caro.ipa: /ɛt ˈwɛr.bʊm ˈka.roː ˈfak.tʊm ɛst ɛt ha.bɪ.ˈtaː.wɪt ɪn ˈnoː.biːs/
q-vulg-verbum-caro.respelling: et WER-bum KA-roh FAK-tum est et ha-bi-TAH-wit in NOH-bees
q-vulg-verbum-caro.latin: Et Verbum carō factum est et habitāvit in nōbīs.

q-vulg-exiit-edictum.ipa: /ˈɛk.sɪ.ɪt eː.ˈdɪk.tʊm aː ˈkae̯.sa.rɛ au̯.ˈgʊs.toː ʊt deːs.kriː.bɛ.ˈreː.tʊr uː.nɪ.ˈwɛr.sʊs ˈɔr.bɪs/
q-vulg-exiit-edictum.respelling: EK-si-it ay-DIK-tum ah KEYE-sa-re ow-GUS-toh ut days-kree-be-RAY-tur oo-ni-WER-sus OR-bis
q-vulg-exiit-edictum.latin: Exiit ēdictum ā Caesare Augustō ut dēscrīberētur ūniversus orbis.

q-creed-pilato.ipa: /ˈpas.sʊs sʊb ˈpɔn.tɪ.oː piː.ˈlaː.toː krʊ.kɪ.ˈfiːk.sʊs ˈmɔr.tʊ.ʊs ɛt sɛ.ˈpʊl.tʊs/
q-creed-pilato.respelling: PAS-sus sub PON-ti-oh pee-LAH-toh kru-ki-FEEK-sus MOR-tu-us et se-PUL-tus
q-creed-pilato.latin: Passus sub Pontiō Pīlātō, crucifīxus, mortuus, et sepultus.

q-tacitus-christus.ipa: /ˈau̯k.tɔr ˈnoː.mɪ.nɪs ˈɛj.jʊs ˈkʰriːs.tʊs tɪ.ˈbɛ.rɪ.oː ɪm.pɛ.rɪ.ˈtan.tɛ pɛr proː.kuː.raː.ˈtoː.rɛm ˈpɔn.tɪ.ʊm piː.ˈlaː.tʊm sʊp.ˈplɪ.kɪ.oː ad.ˈfɛk.tʊs ˈɛ.rat/
q-tacitus-christus.respelling: OWK-tor NOH-mi-nis AY-yus KREES-tus ti-BE-ri-oh im-pe-ri-TAN-te per proh-koo-rah-TOH-rem PON-ti-um pee-LAH-tum sup-PLI-ki-oh ad-FEK-tus E-rat
q-tacitus-christus.latin: Auctor nōminis eius Chrīstus Tiberiō imperitante per prōcūrātōrem Pontium Pīlātum suppliciō adfectus erat.

q-pliny-carmen-christo.ipa: /ˈkar.mɛn ˈkʰriːs.toː ˈkʷa.sɪ ˈdɛ.oː ˈdiː.kɛ.rɛ ˈseː.kʊm ˈɪn.wɪ.kɛm/
q-pliny-carmen-christo.respelling: KAR-men KREES-toh KWA-si DE-oh DEE-ke-re SAY-kum IN-wi-kem
q-pliny-carmen-christo.latin: Carmen Chrīstō quasi deō dīcere sēcum invicem

q-jerome-capitur-urbs.respelling: KA-pi-tur urps kweye TOH-tum KAY-pit OR-bem
q-jerome-capitur-urbs.latin: Capitur urbs quae tōtum cēpit orbem.

q-bede-britannia.ipa: /brɪt.ˈta.nɪ.a oː.ˈkɛ.a.niː ˈiːn.sʊ.la kui̯ ˈkʷɔn.dam ˈal.bɪ.oːn ˈnoː.mɛn ˈfʊ.ɪt/
q-bede-britannia.respelling: brit-TA-ni-a oh-KE-a-nee EEN-su-la koo-ee KWON-dam AL-bi-ohn NOH-men FU-it
q-bede-britannia.latin: Brittania Ōceanī īnsula, cui quondam Albiōn nōmen fuit

q-benedict-mortem.respelling: MOR-tem ko-TEE-di-ay AN-te O-ku-lohs sus-PEK-tam ha-BAY-re
q-benedict-mortem.latin: Mortem cotīdiē ante oculōs suspectam habēre.

q-benedict-genera.respelling: mo-na-KOH-rum KWAT-tu-or ES-se GE-ne-ra ma-ni-FES-tum est
q-benedict-genera.latin: Monachōrum quattuor esse genera manifestum est.

q-isidore-litterae.ipa: /ˈlɪt.tɛ.rae̯ ˈau̯.tɛm sʊnt ˈɪn.dɪ.keːs ˈreː.rʊm ˈsɪŋ.na wɛr.ˈboː.rʊm ˈkʷɪ.bʊs ˈtan.ta wiːs ɛst ʊt ˈnoː.biːs ˈdɪk.ta ap.ˈsɛn.tɪ.ʊm ˈsɪ.nɛ ˈwoː.kɛ lɔ.ˈkʷan.tʊr/
q-isidore-litterae.respelling: LIT-te-reye OW-tem sunt IN-di-kays RAY-rum SING-na wer-BOH-rum KWI-bus TAN-ta wees est ut NOH-bees DIK-ta ap-SEN-ti-um SI-ne WOH-ke lo-KWAN-tur
q-isidore-litterae.latin: Litterae autem sunt indicēs rērum, signa verbōrum, quibus tanta vīs est, ut nōbīs dicta absentium sine vōce loquantur.

q-alcuin-vox-populi.ipa: /nɛk au̯.dɪ.ˈɛn.diː kʷiː ˈsɔ.lɛnt ˈdiː.kɛ.rɛ woːks ˈpɔ.pʊ.liː woːks ˈdɛ.iː/
q-alcuin-vox-populi.respelling: nek ow-di-EN-dee kwee SO-lent DEE-ke-re wohks PO-pu-lee wohks DE-ee
q-alcuin-vox-populi.latin: Nec audiendī quī solent dīcere: "Vōx populī, vōx Deī."

q-anselm-credo.ipa: /ˈnɛ.kʷɛ ˈɛ.nɪm ˈkʷae̯.roː ɪn.tɛl.ˈlɪ.gɛ.rɛ ʊt ˈkreː.dam sɛd ˈkreː.doː ʊt ɪn.ˈtɛl.lɪ.gam/
q-anselm-credo.respelling: NE-kwe E-nim KWEYE-roh in-tel-LI-ge-re ut KRAY-dam sed KRAY-doh ut in-TEL-li-gam
q-anselm-credo.latin: Neque enim quaerō intelligere ut crēdam, sed crēdō ut intelligam.

q-seneca-pauper.ipa: /noːn kʷiː ˈpa.rʊm ˈha.bɛt sɛd kʷiː pluːs ˈkʊ.pɪt ˈpau̯.pɛr ɛst/
q-seneca-pauper.respelling: nohn kwee PA-rum HA-bet sed kwee ploos KU-pit POW-per est
q-seneca-pauper.latin: Nōn quī parum habet, sed quī plūs cupit, pauper est.

q-seneca-philologia.respelling: kweye pi-lo-SO-pi-a FU-it FAK-ta pi-lo-LO-gi-a est
q-seneca-philologia.latin: Quae philosophia fuit, facta philologia est.

q-cicero-socrates-nihil.latin: … nihil sē scīre dīcat nisi id ipsum

q-cicero-errare.ipa: /ˈkʊj.jʊ.swiːs ˈhɔ.mɪ.nɪs ɛst ɛr.ˈraː.rɛ nuːl.ˈliː.ʊs ˈnɪ.sɪ iːn.sɪ.pɪ.ˈɛn.tɪs ɪn ɛr.ˈroː.rɛ pɛr.sɛ.weː.ˈraː.rɛ/
q-cicero-errare.respelling: KOOY-yu-swees HO-mi-nis est er-RAH-re nool-LEE-us NI-si een-si-pi-EN-tis in er-ROH-re per-se-way-RAH-re
q-cicero-errare.latin: Cuiusvīs hominis est errāre, nūllīus nisi īnsipientis in errōre persevērāre.

q-aug-civitates.ipa: /feː.ˈkeː.rʊnt ˈɪ.ta.kʷɛ kiː.wɪ.ˈtaː.teːs ˈdʊ.aːs a.ˈmoː.reːs ˈdʊ.ɔ tɛr.ˈreː.nam ˈskiː.lɪ.kɛt ˈa.mɔr ˈsʊ.iː ˈʊs.kʷɛ ad kɔn.ˈtɛmp.tʊm ˈdɛ.iː kae̯.ˈlɛs.tɛm ˈweː.roː ˈa.mɔr ˈdɛ.iː ˈʊs.kʷɛ ad kɔn.ˈtɛmp.tʊm ˈsʊ.iː/
q-aug-civitates.respelling: fay-KAY-runt I-ta-kwe kee-wi-TAH-tays DU-ahs a-MOH-rays DU-o ter-RAY-nam SKEE-li-ket A-mor SU-ee US-kwe ad kon-TEMP-tum DE-ee keye-LES-tem WAY-roh A-mor DE-ee US-kwe ad kon-TEMP-tum SU-ee
q-aug-civitates.latin: Fēcērunt itaque cīvitātēs duās amōrēs duo, terrēnam scīlicet amor suī usque ad contemptum Deī, caelestem vērō amor Deī usque ad contemptum suī.

q-vulg-petrus.ipa: /tuː ɛs ˈpɛ.trʊs ɛt ˈsʊ.pɛr haŋk ˈpɛ.tram ae̯.dɪ.fɪ.ˈkaː.boː ɛk.ˈkleː.sɪ.am ˈmɛ.am/
q-vulg-petrus.respelling: too es PE-trus et SU-per hangk PE-tram eye-di-fi-KAH-boh ek-KLAY-si-am ME-am
q-vulg-petrus.latin: Tū es Petrus, et super hanc petram aedificābō ecclēsiam meam.

q-vulg-dominus-reget.ipa: /ˈdɔ.mɪ.nʊs ˈrɛ.gɛt meː ɛt ˈnɪ.hɪl ˈmɪ.hɪ ˈdɛ.ɛ.rɪt/
q-vulg-dominus-reget.respelling: DO-mi-nus RE-get may et NI-hil MI-hi DE-e-rit
q-vulg-dominus-reget.latin: Dominus reget mē, et nihil mihi deerit.

q-vulg-reddite.ipa: /ˈrɛd.dɪ.tɛ ˈɛr.goː kʷae̯ sʊnt ˈkae̯.sa.rɪs ˈkae̯.sa.riː ɛt kʷae̯ sʊnt ˈdɛ.iː ˈdɛ.oː/
q-vulg-reddite.respelling: RED-di-te ER-goh kweye sunt KEYE-sa-ris KEYE-sa-ree et kweye sunt DE-ee DE-oh
q-vulg-reddite.latin: Reddite ergō quae sunt Caesaris Caesarī, et quae sunt Deī Deō.

q-martin-miles.ipa: /ˈkʰriːs.tiː ˈɛ.gɔ ˈmiː.lɛs sʊm pʊŋ.ˈnaː.rɛ ˈmɪ.hɪ noːn ˈlɪ.kɛt/
q-martin-miles.respelling: KREES-tee E-go MEE-les sum pung-NAH-re MI-hi nohn LI-ket
q-martin-miles.latin: Chrīstī ego mīles sum: pugnāre mihi nōn licet.

q-boethius-carmina.ipa: /ˈkar.mɪ.na kʷiː ˈkʷɔn.dam ˈstʊ.dɪ.oː floː.ˈrɛn.tɛ pɛ.ˈreː.giː ˈfleː.bɪ.lɪs heu̯ ˈmae̯s.toːs ˈkoː.gɔr ɪ.ˈniː.rɛ ˈmɔ.doːs/
q-boethius-carmina.respelling: KAR-mi-na kwee KWON-dam STU-di-oh floh-REN-te pe-RAY-gee FLAY-bi-lis hew MEYES-tohs KOH-gor i-NEE-re MO-dohs
q-boethius-carmina.latin: Carmina quī quondam studiō flōrente perēgī, flēbilis heu maestōs cōgor inīre modōs.

q-vulg-pulvis.respelling: PUL-wis es et in PUL-we-rem re-wer-TAY-ris
q-vulg-pulvis.latin: Pulvis es, et in pulverem revertēris.

q-patrick-ego.ipa: /ˈɛ.gɔ pa.ˈtrɪ.kɪ.ʊs pɛk.ˈkaː.tɔr ruːs.tɪ.ˈkɪs.sɪ.mʊs ɛt ˈmɪ.nɪ.mʊs ˈɔm.nɪ.ʊm fɪ.ˈdeː.lɪ.ʊm/
q-patrick-ego.respelling: E-go pa-TRI-ki-us pek-KAH-tor roos-ti-KIS-si-mus et MI-ni-mus OM-ni-um fi-DAY-li-um
q-patrick-ego.latin: Ego Patricius, peccātor rūsticissimus et minimus omnium fidēlium

q-venantius-vexilla.respelling: wayk-SIL-la RAY-gis PROH-de-unt FUL-get KRU-kis müs-TAY-ri-um
q-venantius-vexilla.latin: Vēxilla rēgis prōdeunt, fulget crucis mystērium

q-bede-caedmon.respelling: nungk low-DAH-re day-BAY-mus owk-TOH-rem RAYNG-nee keye-LES-tis
q-bede-caedmon.latin: Nunc laudāre dēbēmus auctōrem rēgnī caelestis

q-arf-carolo.ipa: /ˈka.rɔ.loː au̯.ˈgʊs.toː aː ˈdɛ.oː kɔ.roː.ˈnaː.toː ˈmaŋ.noː ɛt paː.ˈkɪ.fɪ.koː ɪm.pɛ.raː.ˈtoː.riː roː.maː.ˈnoː.rʊm ˈwiː.ta ɛt wɪk.ˈtoː.rɪ.a/
q-arf-carolo.respelling: KA-ro-loh ow-GUS-toh ah DE-oh ko-roh-NAH-toh MANG-noh et pah-KI-fi-koh im-pe-rah-TOH-ree roh-mah-NOH-rum WEE-ta et wik-TOH-ri-a
q-arf-carolo.latin: Carolō augustō, ā Deō corōnātō magnō et pācificō imperātōrī Rōmānōrum, vīta et victōria!

q-ben-adiutorium.ipa: /ˈdɛ.ʊs ɪn a.dɪ.uː.ˈtoː.rɪ.ʊm ˈmɛ.ʊm ɪn.ˈtɛn.dɛ ˈdɔ.mɪ.nɛ ad a.dɪ.ʊ.ˈwan.dʊm meː fɛs.ˈtiː.naː/
q-ben-adiutorium.respelling: DE-us in a-di-oo-TOH-ri-um ME-um in-TEN-de DO-mi-ne ad a-di-u-WAN-dum may fes-TEE-nah
q-ben-adiutorium.latin: Deus, in adiūtōrium meum intende; Domine, ad adiuvandum mē festīnā.

q-histbrit-arthur.ipa: /tʊŋk ˈar.tʰʊr pʊŋ.ˈnaː.bat ˈkɔn.traː ˈɪl.loːs ɪn ˈɪl.liːs dɪ.ˈeː.bʊs kʊm ˈreː.gɪ.bʊs ˈbrɪt.tɔ.nʊm sɛd ˈɪp.sɛ ˈɛ.rat dʊks bɛl.ˈloː.rʊm/
q-histbrit-arthur.respelling: tungk AR-tur pung-NAH-bat KON-trah IL-lohs in IL-lees di-AY-bus kum RAY-gi-bus BRIT-to-num sed IP-se E-rat duks bel-LOH-rum
q-histbrit-arthur.latin: Tunc Arthur pugnābat contrā illōs in illīs diēbus cum rēgibus Brittonum, sed ipse erat dux bellōrum.

q-asser-codicem.ipa: /ˈkʷɪs.kʷɪs ˈwɛs.trʊm ˈdɪs.kɛ.rɛ ˈkɪ.tɪ.ʊs ˈɪs.tʊm ˈkoː.dɪ.kɛm ˈpɔs.sɪt ˈda.boː ˈɪl.liː ˈɪl.lʊm/
q-asser-codicem.respelling: KWIS-kwis WES-trum DIS-ke-re KI-ti-us IS-tum KOH-di-kem POS-sit DA-boh IL-lee IL-lum
q-asser-codicem.latin: Quisquis vestrum discere citius istum cōdicem possit, dabō illī illum.

q-te-deum.respelling: tay DE-um low-DAH-mus tay DO-mi-num kohn-fi-TAY-mur
q-te-deum.latin: Tē Deum laudāmus: tē Dominum cōnfitēmur.

q-cb-in-taberna.ipa: /ɪn ta.ˈbɛr.naː ˈkʷan.doː ˈsʊ.mʊs noːn kuː.ˈraː.mʊs kʷɪd sɪt ˈhʊ.mʊs/
q-cb-in-taberna.respelling: in ta-BER-nah KWAN-doh SU-mus nohn koo-RAH-mus kwid sit HU-mus
q-cb-in-taberna.latin: In tabernā quandō sumus, nōn cūrāmus quid sit humus

q-stabat-mater.ipa: /ˈstaː.bat ˈmaː.tɛr dɔ.loː.ˈroː.sa ˈjuːk.staː ˈkrʊ.kɛm la.krɪ.ˈmoː.sa dʊm pɛn.ˈdeː.bat ˈfiː.lɪ.ʊs/
q-stabat-mater.respelling: STAH-bat MAH-ter do-loh-ROH-sa YOOK-stah KRU-kem la-kri-MOH-sa dum pen-DAY-bat FEE-li-us
q-stabat-mater.latin: Stābat māter dolōrōsa iūxtā crucem lacrimōsa, dum pendēbat fīlius

q-abelard-o-quanta.ipa: /oː ˈkʷan.ta ˈkʷaː.lɪ.a sʊnt ˈɪl.la ˈsab.ba.ta kʷae̯ ˈsɛm.pɛr ˈkɛ.lɛ.brat sʊ.ˈpɛr.na ˈkuː.rɪ.a/
q-abelard-o-quanta.respelling: oh KWAN-ta KWAH-li-a sunt IL-la SAB-ba-ta kweye SEM-per KE-le-brat su-PER-na KOO-ri-a
q-abelard-o-quanta.latin: Ō quanta, quālia sunt illa sabbata, quae semper celebrat superna cūria!

q-aquinas-quinque.ipa: /rɛs.ˈpɔn.dɛ.oː diː.ˈkɛn.dʊm kʷɔd ˈdɛ.ʊm ˈɛs.sɛ ˈkʷiːŋ.kʷɛ ˈwɪ.iːs prɔ.ˈbaː.riː ˈpɔ.tɛst/
q-aquinas-quinque.respelling: res-PON-de-oh dee-KEN-dum kwod DE-um ES-se KWEENG-kwe WI-ees pro-BAH-ree PO-test
q-aquinas-quinque.latin: Respondeō dīcendum quod Deum esse quīnque viīs probārī potest.

q-bernard-stat-roma.ipa: /stat ˈroː.ma ˈpriːs.tɪ.na ˈnoː.mɪ.nɛ ˈnoː.mɪ.na ˈnuː.da tɛ.ˈneː.mʊs/
q-bernard-stat-roma.respelling: stat ROH-ma PREES-ti-na NOH-mi-ne NOH-mi-na NOO-da te-NAY-mus
q-bernard-stat-roma.latin: Stat Rōma prīstina nōmine, nōmina nūda tenēmus.

q-arbroath.ipa: /noːn ˈɛ.nɪm ˈprɔp.tɛr ˈgloː.rɪ.am diː.ˈwɪ.tɪ.aːs au̯t hɔ.ˈnoː.reːs pʊŋ.ˈnaː.mʊs sɛd ˈprɔp.tɛr liː.bɛr.ˈtaː.tɛm soː.ˈlʊm.mɔ.dɔ kʷam ˈneː.moː ˈbɔ.nʊs ˈnɪ.sɪ ˈsɪ.mʊl kʊm ˈwiː.taː aː.ˈmɪt.tɪt/
q-arbroath.respelling: nohn E-nim PROP-ter GLOH-ri-am dee-WI-ti-ahs owt ho-NOH-rays pung-NAH-mus sed PROP-ter lee-ber-TAH-tem soh-LUM-mo-do kwam NAY-moh BO-nus NI-si SI-mul kum WEE-tah ah-MIT-tit
q-arbroath.latin: Nōn enim propter glōriam, dīvitiās aut honōrēs pugnāmus, sed propter lībertātem sōlummodo, quam nēmō bonus nisi simul cum vītā āmittit.

q-kempis-nesciri.respelling: A-mah nes-KEE-ree et proh NI-hi-loh re-pu-TAH-ree
q-kempis-nesciri.latin: Amā nescīrī, et prō nihilō reputārī.

q-debury-magistri.ipa: /hiː sʊnt ma.ˈgɪs.triː kʷiː noːs ˈiːns.trʊ.ʊnt ˈsɪ.nɛ ˈwɪr.giːs ɛt ˈfɛ.rʊ.laː/
q-debury-magistri.respelling: hee sunt ma-GIS-tree kwee nohs EENS-tru-unt SI-ne WIR-gees et FE-ru-lah
q-debury-magistri.latin: Hī sunt magistrī quī nōs īnstruunt sine virgīs et ferulā.

q-dante-nobilior.respelling: HAH-rum KWO-kwe du-AH-rum noh-BI-li-or est wul-GAH-ris
q-dante-nobilior.latin: Hārum quoque duārum nōbilior est vulgāris.

q-inst-iustitia.ipa: /juːs.ˈtɪ.tɪ.a ɛst ˈkoːns.taːns ɛt pɛr.ˈpɛ.tʊ.a wɔ.ˈlʊn.taːs juːs ˈsʊ.ʊm ˈkui̯.kʷɛ ˈtrɪ.bʊ.eːns/
q-inst-iustitia.respelling: yoos-TI-ti-a est KOHNS-tahns et per-PE-tu-a wo-LUN-tahs yoos SU-um KOO-EE-kwe TRI-bu-ayns
q-inst-iustitia.latin: Iūstitia est cōnstāns et perpetua voluntās iūs suum cuique tribuēns.

q-dig-praecepta.ipa: /ˈjuː.rɪs prae̯.ˈkɛp.ta sʊnt hae̯k hɔ.ˈnɛs.teː ˈwiː.wɛ.rɛ ˈal.tɛ.rʊm noːn ˈlae̯.dɛ.rɛ ˈsʊ.ʊm ˈkui̯.kʷɛ trɪ.ˈbʊ.ɛ.rɛ/
q-dig-praecepta.respelling: YOO-ris preye-KEP-ta sunt heyek ho-NES-tay WEE-we-re AL-te-rum nohn LEYE-de-re SU-um KOO-EE-kwe tri-BU-e-re
q-dig-praecepta.latin: Iūris praecepta sunt haec: honestē vīvere, alterum nōn laedere, suum cuique tribuere.

q-dig-benigniora.respelling: SEM-per in DU-bi-ees be-ning-ni-OH-ra preye-fe-REN-da sunt
q-dig-benigniora.latin: Semper in dubiīs benigniōra praeferenda sunt.

q-dig-dura-lex.ipa: /kʷɔd ˈkʷɪ.dɛm ˈpɛr.kʷam ˈduː.rʊm ɛst sɛd ˈɪ.ta leːks ˈskriːp.ta ɛst/
q-dig-dura-lex.respelling: kwod KWI-dem PER-kwam DOO-rum est sed I-ta layks SKREEP-ta est
q-dig-dura-lex.latin: Quod quidem perquam dūrum est, sed ita lēx scrīpta est.

q-seneca-medea.ipa: /kʷiː ˈsta.tʊ.ɪt ˈa.lɪ.kʷɪd ˈpar.tɛ ɪ.nau̯.ˈdiː.taː ˈal.tɛ.raː ˈae̯.kʷʊm ˈlɪ.kɛt sta.ˈtʊ.ɛ.rɪt hau̯d ˈae̯.kʷʊs ˈfʊ.ɪt/
q-seneca-medea.respelling: kwee STA-tu-it A-li-kwid PAR-te i-now-DEE-tah AL-te-rah EYE-kwum LI-ket sta-TU-e-rit howd EYE-kwus FU-it
q-seneca-medea.latin: Quī statuit aliquid parte inaudītā alterā, aequum licet statuerit, haud aequus fuit.

q-cicero-servi-legum.ipa: /ˈleː.gʊm ˈdeː.nɪ.kʷɛ ɪd.ˈkɪr.koː ˈɔm.neːs ˈsɛr.wiː ˈsʊ.mʊs ʊt ˈliː.bɛ.riː ˈɛs.sɛ pɔs.ˈsiː.mʊs/
q-cicero-servi-legum.respelling: LAY-gum DAY-ni-kwe id-KIR-koh OM-nays SER-wee SU-mus ut LEE-be-ree ES-se pos-SEE-mus
q-cicero-servi-legum.latin: Lēgum dēnique idcircō omnēs servī sumus, ut līberī esse possīmus.

q-bracton-lex.ipa: /ˈɪp.sɛ ˈau̯.tɛm reːks noːn ˈdeː.bɛt ˈɛs.sɛ sʊb ˈhɔ.mɪ.nɛ sɛd sʊb ˈdɛ.oː ɛt sʊb ˈleː.gɛ ˈkʷɪ.a leːks ˈfa.kɪt ˈreː.gɛm/
q-bracton-lex.respelling: IP-se OW-tem rayks nohn DAY-bet ES-se sub HO-mi-ne sed sub DE-oh et sub LAY-ge KWI-a layks FA-kit RAY-gem
q-bracton-lex.latin: Ipse autem rēx nōn dēbet esse sub homine sed sub Deō et sub lēge, quia lēx facit rēgem.

q-cj-omnes-tangit.ipa: /kʷɔd ˈɔm.neːs sɪ.ˈmɪ.lɪ.tɛr ˈtaŋ.gɪt ab ˈɔm.nɪ.bʊs kɔm.prɔ.ˈbeː.tʊr/
q-cj-omnes-tangit.respelling: kwod OM-nays si-MI-li-ter TANG-git ab OM-ni-bus kom-pro-BAY-tur
q-cj-omnes-tangit.latin: Quod omnēs similiter tangit, ab omnibus comprobētur.

q-copernicus-sol.respelling: in ME-di-oh WAY-roh OM-ni-um RE-si-det sohl
q-copernicus-sol.latin: In mediō vērō omnium residet Sōl.

q-galileo-lunam.ipa: /ˈluː.nam sʊ.pɛr.ˈfɪ.kɪ.eː ˈleː.niː ɛt pɛr.pɔ.ˈliː.taː neː.ˈkʷaː.kʷam ˈɛs.sɛ ɪn.ˈduː.tam sɛd ˈas.pɛ.raː ɛt ɪ.nae̯.ˈkʷaː.liː/
q-galileo-lunam.respelling: LOO-nam su-per-FI-ki-ay LAY-nee et per-po-LEE-tah nay-KWAH-kwam ES-se in-DOO-tam sed AS-pe-rah et i-neye-KWAH-lee
q-galileo-lunam.latin: … Lūnam superficiē lēnī et perpolītā nēquāquam esse indūtam, sed asperā et inaequālī

q-newton-lex1.ipa: /ˈkɔr.pʊs ˈɔm.nɛ pɛr.sɛ.weː.ˈraː.rɛ ɪn ˈsta.tuː ˈsʊ.oː kʷɪ.eːs.ˈkɛn.diː wɛl mɔ.ˈwɛn.diː uː.nɪ.ˈfoːr.mɪ.tɛr ɪn diː.ˈreːk.tʊm ˈnɪ.sɪ ˈkʷaː.tɛ.nʊs aː ˈwiː.rɪ.bʊs ɪm.ˈprɛs.siːs ˈkoː.gɪ.tʊr ˈsta.tʊm ˈɪl.lʊm muː.ˈtaː.rɛ/
q-newton-lex1.respelling: KOR-pus OM-ne per-se-way-RAH-re in STA-too SU-oh kwi-ays-KEN-dee wel mo-WEN-dee oo-ni-FOHR-mi-ter in dee-RAYK-tum NI-si KWAH-te-nus ah WEE-ri-bus im-PRES-sees KOH-gi-tur STA-tum IL-lum moo-TAH-re
q-newton-lex1.latin: Corpus omne persevērāre in statū suō quiēscendī vel movendī ūnifōrmiter in dīrēctum, nisi quātenus ā vīribus impressīs cōgitur statum illum mūtāre.

q-columbus-insulas.ipa: /ɪn ˈma.rɛ ˈɪn.dɪ.kʊm pɛr.ˈweː.niː ˈʊ.bɪ ˈpluː.rɪ.maːs ˈiːn.sʊ.laːs ɪn.ˈnʊ.mɛ.riːs ha.bɪ.ˈtaː.taːs hɔ.ˈmɪ.nɪ.bʊs ˈrɛ.pɛ.riː/
q-columbus-insulas.respelling: in MA-re IN-di-kum per-WAY-nee U-bi PLOO-ri-mahs EEN-su-lahs in-NU-me-rees ha-bi-TAH-tahs ho-MI-ni-bus RE-pe-ree
q-columbus-insulas.latin: In mare Indicum pervēnī, ubi plūrimās īnsulās innumerīs habitātās hominibus reperī.

q-more-utopia.ipa: /deː ˈɔp.tɪ.moː rɛ.iː.ˈpuː.blɪ.kae̯ ˈsta.tuː ˈdeː.kʷɛ ˈnɔ.waː ˈiːn.sʊ.laː uː.ˈtɔ.pɪ.aː/
q-more-utopia.respelling: day OP-ti-moh re-ee-POO-bli-keye STA-too DAY-kwe NO-wah EEN-su-lah oo-TO-pi-ah
q-more-utopia.latin: … dē optimō reīpūblicae statū dēque novā īnsulā Ūtopiā

q-gravissimas.ipa: /ˈdɛ.kɛm ˈdɪ.eːs ɪŋ.kluː.ˈsiː.weː aː ˈtɛr.tɪ.aː noː.ˈnaː.rʊm ˈʊs.kʷɛ ad ˈpriː.dɪ.eː ˈiː.duːs ɛk.sɪ.ˈman.tʊr/
q-gravissimas.respelling: DE-kem DI-ays ing-kloo-SEE-way ah TER-ti-ah noh-NAH-rum US-kwe ad PREE-di-ay EE-doos ek-si-MAN-tur
q-gravissimas.latin: … decem diēs inclūsīvē ā tertiā Nōnārum usque ad prīdiē Īdūs eximantur

q-anselm-maius.ipa: /ɛt ˈkʷɪ.dɛm ˈkreː.dɪ.mʊs teː ˈɛs.sɛ ˈa.lɪ.kʷɪd kʷoː ˈnɪ.hɪl ˈmaj.jʊs koː.gɪ.ˈtaː.riː ˈpɔs.sɪt/
q-anselm-maius.respelling: et KWI-dem KRAY-di-mus tay ES-se A-li-kwid kwoh NI-hil MEYE-yus koh-gi-TAH-ree POS-sit
q-anselm-maius.latin: Et quidem crēdimus tē esse aliquid quō nihil maius cōgitārī possit.

q-cb-omittamus.ipa: /ɔ.mɪt.ˈtaː.mʊs ˈstʊ.dɪ.a ˈdʊl.kɛ ɛst deː.ˈsɪ.pɛ.rɛ ɛt kar.ˈpaː.mʊs ˈdʊl.kɪ.a jʊ.wɛn.ˈtuː.tɪs ˈtɛ.nɛ.rae̯/
q-cb-omittamus.respelling: o-mit-TAH-mus STU-di-a DUL-ke est day-SI-pe-re et kar-PAH-mus DUL-ki-a yu-wen-TOO-tis TE-ne-reye
q-cb-omittamus.latin: Omittāmus studia, dulce est dēsipere, et carpāmus dulcia iuventūtis tenerae!

q-kempis-operari.ipa: /ˈmʊl.ta ˈbɔ.na ˈpɔ.tɛs ɔ.pɛ.ˈraː.riː dʊm ˈsaː.nʊs ɛs sɛd iːn.fɪr.ˈmaː.tʊs ˈnɛs.kɪ.oː kʷɪd ˈpɔ.tɛ.rɪs/
q-kempis-operari.respelling: MUL-ta BO-na PO-tes o-pe-RAH-ree dum SAH-nus es sed een-fir-MAH-tus NES-ki-oh kwid PO-te-ris
q-kempis-operari.latin: Multa bona potes operārī dum sānus es, sed īnfirmātus nesciō quid poteris.

q-oresme-moneta.ipa: /mɔ.ˈneː.ta ˈsɪ.kʷɪ.dɛm ɛst iːns.truː.ˈmɛn.tʊm ae̯.ˈkʷɪ.wa.leːns pɛr.muː.ˈtan.diː diː.ˈwɪ.tɪ.aːs naː.tuː.ˈraː.leːs/
q-oresme-moneta.respelling: mo-NAY-ta SI-kwi-dem est eens-troo-MEN-tum eye-KWI-wa-layns per-moo-TAN-dee dee-WI-ti-ahs nah-too-RAH-lays
q-oresme-moneta.latin: Monēta siquidem est īnstrūmentum aequivalēns permūtandī dīvitiās nātūrālēs.

q-petrarch-irascimur.respelling: WAY-rees re-pre-hayn-si-OH-ni-bus ee-RAHS-ki-mur WAY-rees LOW-di-bus day-lek-TAH-mur
q-petrarch-irascimur.latin: Vērīs reprehēnsiōnibus īrāscimur, vērīs laudibus dēlectāmur.

q-asser-libris.ipa: /ɛt ˈpsal.moːs ɛt sak.ˈsɔ.nɪ.koːs ˈlɪ.broːs ɛt ˈmak.sɪ.meː sak.ˈsɔ.nɪ.ka ˈkar.mɪ.na stʊ.dɪ.ˈoː.seː dɪ.dɪ.ˈkeː.rɛ ɛt frɛ.kʷɛn.ˈtɪs.sɪ.meː ˈlɪ.briːs uː.ˈtʊn.tʊr/
q-asser-libris.respelling: et PSAL-mohs et sak-SO-ni-kohs LI-brohs et MAK-si-may sak-SO-ni-ka KAR-mi-na stu-di-OH-say di-di-KAY-re et fre-kwen-TIS-si-may LI-brees oo-TUN-tur
q-asser-libris.latin: … et psalmōs et Saxonicōs librōs et maximē Saxonica carmina studiōsē didicēre, et frequentissimē librīs ūtuntur.

q-dig-operam.ipa: /ˈjuː.riː ˈɔ.pɛ.ram da.ˈtuː.rʊm ˈprɪ.ʊs ˈnoːs.sɛ ɔ.ˈpɔr.tɛt ˈʊn.dɛ ˈnoː.mɛn ˈjuː.rɪs deːs.ˈkɛn.dat/
q-dig-operam.respelling: YOO-ree O-pe-ram da-TOO-rum PRI-us NOHS-se o-POR-tet UN-de NOH-men YOO-ris days-KEN-dat
q-dig-operam.latin: Iūrī operam datūrum prius nōsse oportet, unde nōmen iūris dēscendat.

q-dig-licet.respelling: nohn OM-ne kwod LI-ket ho-NES-tum est
q-dig-licet.latin: Nōn omne quod licet honestum est.

q-dig-suo-iure.ipa: /ˈnuːl.lʊs wɪ.ˈdeː.tʊr ˈdɔ.loː ˈfa.kɛ.rɛ kʷiː ˈsʊ.oː ˈjuː.rɛ ˈuː.tɪ.tʊr/
q-dig-suo-iure.respelling: NOOL-lus wi-DAY-tur DO-loh FA-ke-re kwee SU-oh YOO-re OO-ti-tur
q-dig-suo-iure.latin: Nūllus vidētur dolō facere, quī suō iūre ūtitur.

q-tacitus-leges.respelling: et kor-rup-TIS-si-mah ray POO-bli-kah PLOO-ri-meye LAY-gays
q-tacitus-leges.latin: Et corruptissimā rē pūblicā plūrimae lēgēs.

q-xii-nox-furtum.ipa: /siː nɔks ˈfuːr.tʊm ˈfak.sɪt siː ɔk.ˈkiː.sɪt ˈjuː.rɛ ˈkae̯.sʊs ˈɛs.toː/
q-xii-nox-furtum.respelling: see noks FOOR-tum FAK-sit see ok-KEE-sit YOO-re KEYE-sus ES-toh
q-xii-nox-furtum.latin: Sī nox fūrtum faxsit, sī occīsit, iūre caesus estō.

v-via-appia.respelling: WI-a AP-pi-a LONG-ga et an-TEE-kwa est
v-via-appia.latin: Via Appia longa et antīqua est.

v-tabulae-stili.ipa: /mɛr.kaː.ˈtoː.reːs ˈta.bʊ.laːs ɛt ˈstɪ.loːs ˈha.bɛnt ɛt ˈlɪt.tɛ.raːs ˈskriː.bʊnt/
v-tabulae-stili.respelling: mer-kah-TOH-rays TA-bu-lahs et STI-lohs HA-bent et LIT-te-rahs SKREE-bunt
v-tabulae-stili.latin: Mercātōrēs tabulās et stilōs habent et litterās scrībunt.

v-aquaeductus.ipa: /ˈa.kʷa aː ˈmɔn.tɪ.bʊs pɛr ka.ˈnaː.lɛm ad ˈʊr.bɛm ˈflʊ.ɪt/
v-aquaeductus.respelling: A-kwa ah MON-ti-bus per ka-NAH-lem ad UR-bem FLU-it
v-aquaeductus.latin: Aqua ā montibus per canālem ad urbem fluit.

v-pantheum.ipa: /a.ˈgrɪp.pa ˈpan.tʰɛ.ʊm ae̯.dɪ.fɪ.ˈkaː.wɪt ˈpɔs.tɛ.aː ha.drɪ.ˈaː.nʊs ˈtɛm.plʊm ˈnɔ.wʊm fa.kɪ.ˈeː.bat/
v-pantheum.respelling: a-GRIP-pa PAN-te-um eye-di-fi-KAH-wit POS-te-ah ha-dri-AH-nus TEM-plum NO-wum fa-ki-AY-bat
v-pantheum.latin: Agrippa Pantheum aedificāvit; posteā Hadriānus templum novum faciēbat.

v-viator-lege.ipa: /wɪ.ˈaː.tɔr ˈla.pɪ.dɛm ˈlɛ.gɛ mɔks ad ˈɔp.pɪ.dʊm ˈwɛ.nɪ.eːs/
v-viator-lege.respelling: wi-AH-tor LA-pi-dem LE-ge moks ad OP-pi-dum WE-ni-ays
v-viator-lege.latin: Viātor, lapidem lege! Mox ad oppidum veniēs.

v-basilica.ipa: /ba.ˈsɪ.lɪ.ka aː mak.ˈsɛn.tɪ.oː ɪŋ.kɔ.ˈhaː.ta aː koːns.tan.ˈtiː.noː pɛr.ˈfɛk.ta ɛst/
v-basilica.respelling: ba-SI-li-ka ah mak-SEN-ti-oh ing-ko-HAH-ta ah kohns-tan-TEE-noh per-FEK-ta est
v-basilica.latin: Basilica ā Maxentiō incohāta, ā Cōnstantīnō perfecta est.

v-cloaca-maxima.ipa: /klɔ.ˈaː.ka ˈmak.sɪ.ma kʷam ˈreː.geːs roː.ˈmaː.niː feː.ˈkeː.rʊnt ˈa.kʷam ɪn ˈtɪ.bɛ.rɪm ˈduː.kɪt/
v-cloaca-maxima.respelling: klo-AH-ka MAK-si-ma kwam RAY-gays roh-MAH-nee fay-KAY-runt A-kwam in TI-be-rim DOO-kit
v-cloaca-maxima.latin: Cloāca Maxima, quam rēgēs Rōmānī fēcērunt, aquam in Tiberim dūcit.

q-quem-pastores.ipa: /kʷɛm paːs.ˈtoː.reːs lau̯.daː.ˈweː.rɛ ˈkʷɪ.bʊs ˈaŋ.gɛ.liː diːk.ˈseː.rɛ ˈap.sɪt ˈwoː.biːs jam tɪ.ˈmeː.rɛ ˈnaː.tʊs ɛst reːks ˈgloː.rɪ.ae̯/
q-quem-pastores.respelling: kwem pahs-TOH-rays low-dah-WAY-re KWI-bus ANG-ge-lee deek-SAY-re AP-sit WOH-bees yam ti-MAY-re NAH-tus est rayks GLOH-ri-eye
q-quem-pastores.latin: Quem pāstōrēs laudāvēre, quibus angelī dīxēre: absit vōbīs iam timēre, nātus est rēx glōriae.

q-puer-nobis.ipa: /kʊm ˈkan.tɪ.bʊs ɪn ˈkʰɔ.roː kʊm ˈkan.tɪ.kiːs ɛt ˈɔr.ga.noː bɛ.nɛ.diː.ˈkaː.mʊs ˈdɔ.mɪ.noː/
q-puer-nobis.respelling: kum KAN-ti-bus in KO-roh kum KAN-ti-kees et OR-ga-noh be-ne-dee-KAH-mus DO-mi-noh
q-puer-nobis.latin: Cum cantibus in chorō, cum canticīs et organō, benedīcāmus Dominō.

q-dies-irae-quid-sum.ipa: /kʷɪd sʊm ˈmɪ.sɛr tʊŋk dɪk.ˈtuː.rʊs kʷɛm pa.ˈtroː.nʊm rɔ.gaː.ˈtuː.rʊs kʊm wɪks ˈjuːs.tʊs sɪt seː.ˈkuː.rʊs/
q-dies-irae-quid-sum.respelling: kwid sum MI-ser tungk dik-TOO-rus kwem pa-TROH-num ro-gah-TOO-rus kum wiks YOOS-tus sit say-KOO-rus
q-dies-irae-quid-sum.latin: Quid sum miser tunc dictūrus, quem patrōnum rogātūrus, cum vix iūstus sit sēcūrus?

q-stabat-quis-homo.ipa: /kʷɪs ɛst ˈhɔ.moː kʷiː noːn ˈfleː.rɛt ˈkʰriːs.tiː ˈmaː.trɛm siː wɪ.ˈdeː.rɛt ɪn ˈtan.toː sʊp.ˈplɪ.kɪ.oː/
q-stabat-quis-homo.respelling: kwis est HO-moh kwee nohn FLAY-ret KREES-tee MAH-trem see wi-DAY-ret in TAN-toh sup-PLI-ki-oh
q-stabat-quis-homo.latin: Quis est homō quī nōn flēret, Chrīstī mātrem sī vidēret in tantō suppliciō?

q-personent-clericuli.ipa: /ˈɔm.neːs kleː.ˈrɪ.kʊ.liː ˈpa.rɪ.tɛr ˈpʊ.ɛ.riː ˈkan.tɛnt ʊt ˈaŋ.gɛ.liː/
q-personent-clericuli.respelling: OM-nays klay-RI-ku-lee PA-ri-ter PU-e-ree KAN-tent ut ANG-ge-lee
q-personent-clericuli.latin: Omnēs clēriculī, pariter puerī, cantent ut angelī.

q-aquinas-utrum.ipa: /ˈpriː.moː ˈʊ.trʊm ˈdɛ.ʊm ˈɛs.sɛ sɪt pɛr seː ˈnoː.tʊm/
q-aquinas-utrum.respelling: PREE-moh U-trum DE-um ES-se sit per say NOH-tum
q-aquinas-utrum.latin: Prīmō, utrum Deum esse sit per sē nōtum.

q-cb-ecce-gratum.ipa: /ˈja.mɪ.am ˈkeː.dant ˈtriːs.tɪ.a ˈae̯s.taːs ˈrɛ.dɪt nʊŋk rɛ.ˈkeː.dɪt ˈhɪ.ɛ.mɪs sae̯.ˈwɪ.tɪ.a/
q-cb-ecce-gratum.respelling: YA-mi-am KAY-dant TREES-ti-a EYES-tahs RE-dit nungk re-KAY-dit HI-e-mis seye-WI-ti-a
q-cb-ecce-gratum.latin: Iamiam cēdant trīstia! Aestās redit, nunc recēdit hiemis saevitia.

q-bernard-plus-potuit.ipa: /au̯t pluːs ˈpɔ.tʊ.ɪt ˈa.dam ɪn ˈma.loː kʷam ˈkʰriːs.tʊs ɪn ˈbɔ.noː/
q-bernard-plus-potuit.respelling: owt ploos PO-tu-it A-dam in MA-loh kwam KREES-tus in BO-noh
q-bernard-plus-potuit.latin: … aut plūs potuit Adam in malō quam Chrīstus in bonō?

q-kempis-utinam.ipa: /ˈʊ.tɪ.nam pɛr ˈuː.nam ˈdɪ.ɛm ˈbɛ.nɛ ɛs.ˈseː.mʊs kɔn.wɛr.ˈsaː.tiː ɪn hoːk ˈmʊn.doː/
q-kempis-utinam.respelling: U-ti-nam per OO-nam DI-em BE-ne es-SAY-mus kon-wer-SAH-tee in hohk MUN-doh
q-kempis-utinam.latin: Utinam per ūnam diem bene essēmus conversātī in hōc mundō.

q-einhard-caenandum.ipa: /ˈɪn.tɛr kae̯.ˈnan.dʊm au̯t ˈa.lɪ.kʷɔd a.krɔ.ˈaː.ma au̯t leːk.ˈtoː.rɛm au̯.dɪ.ˈeː.bat lɛ.geː.ˈban.tʊr ˈɛ.iː hɪs.ˈtɔ.rɪ.ae̯ ɛt an.tiː.ˈkʷoː.rʊm reːs ˈgɛs.tae̯/
q-einhard-caenandum.respelling: IN-ter keye-NAN-dum owt A-li-kwod a-kro-AH-ma owt layk-TOH-rem ow-di-AY-bat le-gay-BAN-tur E-ee his-TO-ri-eye et an-tee-KWOH-rum rays GES-teye
q-einhard-caenandum.latin: Inter caenandum aut aliquod acroāma aut lēctōrem audiēbat. Legēbantur eī historiae et antīquōrum rēs gestae.

q-asser-candelas.ipa: /ˈkʊm.kʷɛ ˈtan.ta ˈkeː.ra meːn.suː.ˈraː.ta fʊ.ˈɪs.sɛt kʷae̯ sɛp.tʊ.aː.ˈgɪn.taː ˈdʊ.oːs deː.ˈnaː.rɪ.oːs peːn.ˈsaː.rɛt sɛks kan.ˈdeː.laːs ka.pɛl.ˈlaː.noːs ˈfa.kɛ.rɛ ˈjʊs.sɪt/
q-asser-candelas.respelling: KUM-kwe TAN-ta KAY-ra mayn-soo-RAH-ta fu-IS-set kweye sep-tu-ah-GIN-tah DU-ohs day-NAH-ri-ohs payn-SAH-ret seks kan-DAY-lahs ka-pel-LAH-nohs FA-ke-re YUS-sit
q-asser-candelas.latin: … cumque tanta cēra mēnsūrāta fuisset, quae septuāgintā duōs dēnāriōs pēnsāret, sex candēlās … capellānōs facere iussit.

q-arbroath-centum.ipa: /ˈkʷɪ.a ˈkʷam.dɪ.uː ˈkɛn.tʊm ɛks ˈnoː.biːs ˈwiː.wiː rɛ.ˈmaːn.sɛ.rɪnt ˈnʊm.kʷam aŋ.ˈgloː.rʊm dɔ.ˈmɪ.nɪ.oː a.lɪ.ˈkʷaː.tɛ.nʊs ˈwɔ.lʊ.mʊs sʊ.bɪ.ʊ.ˈgaː.riː/
q-arbroath-centum.respelling: KWI-a KWAM-di-oo KEN-tum eks NOH-bees WEE-wee re-MAHN-se-rint NUM-kwam ang-GLOH-rum do-MI-ni-oh a-li-KWAH-te-nus WO-lu-mus su-bi-u-GAH-ree
q-arbroath-centum.latin: Quia quamdiū centum ex nōbīs vīvī remānserint, numquam Anglōrum dominiō aliquātenus volumus subiugārī.

q-debury-libris.ipa: /ɪn ˈlɪ.briːs ˈmɔr.tʊ.oːs ˈkʷa.sɪ ˈwiː.woːs ɪn.ˈwɛ.nɪ.oː ɪn ˈlɪ.briːs fʊ.ˈtuː.ra prae̯.ˈwɪ.dɛ.oː/
q-debury-libris.respelling: in LI-brees MOR-tu-ohs KWA-si WEE-wohs in-WE-ni-oh in LI-brees fu-TOO-ra preye-WI-de-oh
q-debury-libris.latin: In librīs mortuōs quasi vīvōs inveniō; in librīs futūra praevideō.

q-magna-carta-nulli.ipa: /ˈnuːl.liː wɛn.ˈdeː.mʊs ˈnuːl.liː nɛ.ˈgaː.bɪ.mʊs au̯t dɪf.fɛ.ˈreː.mʊs ˈreːk.tʊm au̯t juːs.ˈtɪ.tɪ.am/
q-magna-carta-nulli.respelling: NOOL-lee wen-DAY-mus NOOL-lee ne-GAH-bi-mus owt dif-fe-RAY-mus RAYK-tum owt yoos-TI-ti-am
q-magna-carta-nulli.latin: Nūllī vendēmus, nūllī negābimus aut differēmus rēctum aut iūstitiam.

q-oresme-quamvis.ipa: /ˈkʷam.wiːs proː uː.tɪ.lɪ.ˈtaː.tɛ kɔm.ˈmuː.niː ˈpriːŋ.kɛps ˈha.bɛ.at sɪŋ.ˈnaː.rɛ nʊ.ˈmɪs.ma noːn ˈta.mɛn ˈɪp.sɛ ˈdɔ.mɪ.nʊs seu̯ prɔ.prɪ.ɛ.ˈtaː.rɪ.ʊs ɛst mɔ.ˈneː.tae̯ kʊr.ˈrɛn.tɪs ɪn ˈsʊ.oː priːŋ.kɪ.ˈpaː.tuː/
q-oresme-quamvis.respelling: KWAM-wees proh oo-ti-li-TAH-te kom-MOO-nee PREENG-keps HA-be-at sing-NAH-re nu-MIS-ma nohn TA-men IP-se DO-mi-nus sew pro-pri-e-TAH-ri-us est mo-NAY-teye kur-REN-tis in SU-oh preeng-ki-PAH-too
q-oresme-quamvis.latin: Quamvīs prō ūtilitāte commūnī prīnceps habeat signāre numisma, nōn tamen ipse dominus seu proprietārius est monētae currentis in suō prīncipātū.

q-petrarch-vixisti.ipa: /tuː ˈkʷɪ.dɛm ˈkɪ.kɛ.roː kʷɔd ˈpaː.kɛ ˈtʊ.aː ˈdiːk.sɛ.rɪm ʊt ˈhɔ.moː wiːk.ˈsɪs.tiː ʊt oː.ˈraː.tɔr diːk.ˈsɪs.tiː ʊt pʰɪ.ˈlɔ.sɔ.pʰʊs skriːp.ˈsɪs.tiː/
q-petrarch-vixisti.respelling: too KWI-dem KI-ke-roh kwod PAH-ke TU-ah DEEK-se-rim ut HO-moh week-SIS-tee ut oh-RAH-tor deek-SIS-tee ut pi-LO-so-pus skreep-SIS-tee
q-petrarch-vixisti.latin: Tū quidem, Cicerō, quod pāce tuā dīxerim, ut homō vīxistī, ut ōrātor dīxistī, ut philosophus scrīpsistī.

q-dante-monarchia.ipa: /ɛt ɪm.pɛ.raː.ˈtoː.rɛ kʷiː sɛ.ˈkʊn.dʊm pʰɪ.lɔ.ˈsɔ.pʰɪ.ka dɔ.kʊ.ˈmɛn.ta ˈgɛ.nʊs huː.ˈmaː.nʊm ad tɛm.pɔ.ˈraː.lɛm feː.liː.kɪ.ˈtaː.tɛm diː.ˈrɪ.gɛ.rɛt/
q-dante-monarchia.respelling: et im-pe-rah-TOH-re kwee se-KUN-dum pi-lo-SO-pi-ka do-ku-MEN-ta GE-nus hoo-MAH-num ad tem-po-RAH-lem fay-lee-ki-TAH-tem dee-RI-ge-ret
q-dante-monarchia.latin: … et Imperātōre, quī secundum philosophica documenta genus hūmānum ad temporālem fēlīcitātem dīrigeret.

q-xii-sepelito.ipa: /ˈhɔ.mɪ.nɛm ˈmɔr.tʊ.ʊm ɪn ˈʊr.bɛ neː sɛ.pɛ.ˈliː.toː ˈneː.wɛ ˈuː.rɪ.toː/
q-xii-sepelito.respelling: HO-mi-nem MOR-tu-um in UR-be nay se-pe-LEE-toh NAY-we OO-ri-toh
q-xii-sepelito.latin: Hominem mortuum in urbe nē sepelītō nēve ūritō.

q-xii-venum.ipa: /siː ˈpa.tɛr ˈfiː.lɪ.ʊm tɛr ˈweː.nʊm ˈdʊ.ɪt ˈfiː.lɪ.ʊs aː ˈpa.trɛ ˈliː.bɛr ˈɛs.toː/
q-xii-venum.respelling: see PA-ter FEE-li-um ter WAY-num DU-it FEE-li-us ah PA-tre LEE-ber ES-toh
q-xii-venum.latin: Sī pater fīlium ter vēnum duit, fīlius ā patre līber estō.

q-cicero-sunto.ipa: /ˈreː.gɪ.oː ɪm.ˈpɛ.rɪ.oː ˈdʊ.ɔ ˈsʊn.toː miː.ˈlɪ.tɪ.ae̯ ˈsʊm.mʊm juːs ha.ˈbɛn.toː ˈneː.mɪ.niː pa.ˈrɛn.toː/
q-cicero-sunto.respelling: RAY-gi-oh im-PE-ri-oh DU-o SUN-toh mee-LI-ti-eye SUM-mum yoos ha-BEN-toh NAY-mi-nee pa-REN-toh
q-cicero-sunto.latin: Rēgiō imperiō duo suntō … mīlitiae summum iūs habentō, nēminī parentō.

q-dig-placuit.respelling: kwod PREENG-ki-pee PLA-ku-it LAY-gis HA-bet wi-GOH-rem
q-dig-placuit.latin: Quod prīncipī placuit, lēgis habet vigōrem.

q-gaius-omnes-populi.ipa: /ˈɔm.neːs ˈpɔ.pʊ.liː kʷiː ˈleː.gɪ.bʊs ɛt ˈmoː.rɪ.bʊs rɛ.ˈgʊn.tʊr ˈpar.tɪm ˈsʊ.oː ˈprɔ.prɪ.oː ˈpar.tɪm kɔm.ˈmuː.niː ˈɔm.nɪ.ʊm ˈhɔ.mɪ.nʊm ˈjuː.rɛ uː.ˈtʊn.tʊr/
q-gaius-omnes-populi.respelling: OM-nays PO-pu-lee kwee LAY-gi-bus et MOH-ri-bus re-GUN-tur PAR-tim SU-oh PRO-pri-oh PAR-tim kom-MOO-nee OM-ni-um HO-mi-num YOO-re oo-TUN-tur
q-gaius-omnes-populi.latin: Omnēs populī quī lēgibus et mōribus reguntur partim suō propriō, partim commūnī omnium hominum iūre ūtuntur.

q-trajan-conquirendi.ipa: /kɔŋ.kʷiː.ˈrɛn.diː noːn sʊnt siː deː.fɛ.ˈran.tʊr ɛt ar.gʊ.ˈan.tʊr puː.nɪ.ˈɛn.diː sʊnt/
q-trajan-conquirendi.respelling: kong-kwee-REN-dee nohn sunt see day-fe-RAN-tur et ar-gu-AN-tur poo-ni-EN-dee sunt
q-trajan-conquirendi.latin: Conquīrendī nōn sunt; sī dēferantur et arguantur, pūniendī sunt.

q-tacitus-licet-concilium.ipa: /ˈlɪ.kɛt ˈa.pʊd kɔŋ.ˈkɪ.lɪ.ʊm ak.kuː.ˈsaː.rɛ ˈkʷɔ.kʷɛ ɛt dɪs.ˈkriː.mɛn ˈka.pɪ.tɪs ɪn.ˈtɛn.dɛ.rɛ/
q-tacitus-licet-concilium.respelling: LI-ket A-pud kong-KI-li-um ak-koo-SAH-re KWO-kwe et dis-KREE-men KA-pi-tis in-TEN-de-re
q-tacitus-licet-concilium.latin: Licet apud concilium accūsāre quoque et discrīmen capitis intendere.

q-dig-nemo-plus.ipa: /ˈneː.moː pluːs ˈjuː.rɪs ad ˈa.lɪ.ʊm traːns.ˈfɛr.rɛ ˈpɔ.tɛst kʷam ˈɪp.sɛ ha.ˈbeː.rɛt/
q-dig-nemo-plus.respelling: NAY-moh ploos YOO-ris ad A-li-um trahns-FER-re PO-test kwam IP-se ha-BAY-ret
q-dig-nemo-plus.latin: Nēmō plūs iūris ad alium trānsferre potest, quam ipse habēret.

q-livy-fons-iuris.ipa: /kʷiː nʊŋk ˈkʷɔ.kʷɛ ɪn hoːk ɪm.ˈmeːn.soː a.lɪ.ˈaː.rʊm ˈsʊ.pɛr ˈa.lɪ.aːs a.kɛr.waː.ˈtaː.rʊm ˈleː.gʊm ˈkʊ.mʊ.loː foːns ˈɔm.nɪs ˈpuː.blɪ.kiː priː.waː.ˈtiː.kʷɛ ɛst ˈjuː.rɪs/
q-livy-fons-iuris.respelling: kwee nungk KWO-kwe in hohk im-MAYN-soh a-li-AH-rum SU-per A-li-ahs a-ker-wah-TAH-rum LAY-gum KU-mu-loh fohns OM-nis POO-bli-kee pree-wah-TEE-kwe est YOO-ris
q-livy-fons-iuris.latin: … quī nunc quoque, in hōc immēnsō aliārum super aliās acervātārum lēgum cumulō, fōns omnis pūblicī prīvātīque est iūris.

q-bacon-parendo.ipa: /skɪ.ˈɛn.tɪ.a ɛt pɔ.ˈtɛn.tɪ.a huː.ˈmaː.na ɪn ˈɪ.dɛm kɔ.ˈɪŋ.kɪ.dʊnt naː.ˈtuː.ra ˈɛ.nɪm noːn ˈnɪ.sɪ paː.ˈrɛn.doː ˈwɪŋ.kɪ.tʊr/
q-bacon-parendo.respelling: ski-EN-ti-a et po-TEN-ti-a hoo-MAH-na in I-dem ko-ING-ki-dunt nah-TOO-ra E-nim nohn NI-si pah-REN-doh WING-ki-tur
q-bacon-parendo.latin: Scientia et potentia hūmāna in idem coincidunt … Nātūra enim nōn nisi pārendō vincitur.

q-spinoza-praeclara.ipa: /sɛd ˈɔm.nɪ.a prae̯.ˈklaː.ra tam dɪf.fɪ.ˈkɪ.lɪ.a kʷam ˈraː.ra sʊnt/
q-spinoza-praeclara.respelling: sed OM-ni-a preye-KLAH-ra tam dif-fi-KI-li-a kwam RAH-ra sunt
q-spinoza-praeclara.latin: Sed omnia praeclāra tam difficilia quam rāra sunt.

q-more-oves.ipa: /ˈɔ.weːs ˈwɛs.trae̯ tam ɛ.ˈdaː.keːs ˈat.kʷɛ ɪn.ˈdɔ.mɪ.tae̯ ˈɛs.sɛ koe̯.ˈpeː.rʊnt ʊt ˈhɔ.mɪ.neːs ˈdeː.wɔ.rɛnt ˈɪp.soːs/
q-more-oves.respelling: O-ways WES-treye tam e-DAH-kays AT-kwe in-DO-mi-teye ES-se koy-PAY-runt ut HO-mi-nays DAY-wo-rent IP-sohs
q-more-oves.latin: Ovēs vestrae … tam edācēs atque indomitae esse coepērunt, ut hominēs dēvorent ipsōs.

q-luther-thesis1.ipa: /ˈdɔ.mɪ.nʊs ɛt ma.ˈgɪs.tɛr ˈnɔs.tɛr ˈjeː.sʊs ˈkʰriːs.tʊs diː.ˈkɛn.doː pae̯.nɪ.ˈtɛn.tɪ.am ˈa.gɪ.tɛ ˈɔm.nɛm ˈwiː.tam fɪ.ˈdeː.lɪ.ʊm pae̯.nɪ.ˈtɛn.tɪ.am ˈɛs.sɛ ˈwɔ.lʊ.ɪt/
q-luther-thesis1.respelling: DO-mi-nus et ma-GIS-ter NOS-ter YAY-sus KREES-tus dee-KEN-doh peye-ni-TEN-ti-am A-gi-te OM-nem WEE-tam fi-DAY-li-um peye-ni-TEN-ti-am ES-se WO-lu-it
q-luther-thesis1.latin: Dominus et magister noster Iēsus Chrīstus, dīcendō “Paenitentiam agite”, omnem vītam fidēlium paenitentiam esse voluit.

q-pico-adam.ipa: /nɛk ˈkɛr.tam ˈseː.dɛm nɛk ˈprɔ.prɪ.am ˈfa.kɪ.ɛm nɛk ˈmuː.nʊs ˈuːl.lʊm pɛ.kuː.lɪ.ˈaː.rɛ ˈtɪ.bɪ ˈdɛ.dɪ.mʊs oː ˈa.dam/
q-pico-adam.respelling: nek KER-tam SAY-dem nek PRO-pri-am FA-ki-em nek MOO-nus OOL-lum pe-koo-li-AH-re TI-bi DE-di-mus oh A-dam
q-pico-adam.latin: Nec certam sēdem, nec propriam faciem, nec mūnus ūllum pecūliāre tibi dedimus, ō Adam.

q-vespucci-novum-mundum.ipa: /ˈkʷaːs.kʷɛ ˈnɔ.wʊm ˈmʊn.dʊm ap.pɛl.ˈlaː.rɛ ˈlɪ.kɛt ˈkʷan.doː ˈa.pʊd maj.ˈjoː.reːs ˈnɔs.troːs ˈnuːl.la deː ˈɪp.siːs ˈfʊ.ɛ.rɪt ˈha.bɪ.ta kɔŋ.ˈnɪ.tɪ.oː/
q-vespucci-novum-mundum.respelling: KWAHS-kwe NO-wum MUN-dum ap-pel-LAH-re LI-ket KWAN-doh A-pud meye-YOH-rays NOS-trohs NOOL-la day IP-sees FU-e-rit HA-bi-ta kong-NI-ti-oh
q-vespucci-novum-mundum.latin: Quāsque Novum Mundum appellāre licet, quandō apud māiōrēs nostrōs nūlla dē ipsīs fuerit habita cognitiō.

q-kepler-sexangula.ipa: /nam siː ˈkaː.suː fɪt kuːr noːn ˈae̯.kʷeː kʷiːŋ.ˈkʷaŋ.gʊ.la ˈka.dʊnt au̯t sɛp.ˈtaŋ.gʊ.la kuːr ˈsɛm.pɛr sɛk.ˈsaŋ.gʊ.la/
q-kepler-sexangula.respelling: nam see KAH-soo fit koor nohn EYE-kway kweeng-KWANG-gu-la KA-dunt owt sep-TANG-gu-la koor SEM-per sek-SANG-gu-la
q-kepler-sexangula.latin: Nam sī cāsū fit, cūr nōn aequē quīnquangula cadunt, aut septangula, cūr semper sexangula?

q-fulbert-chorus.ipa: /ˈkʰɔ.rʊs ˈnɔ.wae̯ jɛ.ˈruː.sa.lɛm ˈnɔ.wam ˈmɛ.liː dʊl.ˈkeː.dɪ.nɛm ˈproː.mat/
q-fulbert-chorus.respelling: KO-rus NO-weye ye-ROO-sa-lem NO-wam ME-lee dul-KAY-di-nem PROH-mat
q-fulbert-chorus.latin: Chorus novae Ierūsalem novam melī dulcēdinem prōmat.

q-bernard-cluny-hora.respelling: HOH-ra no-WIS-si-ma TEM-po-ra PES-si-ma sunt wi-gi-LAY-mus
q-bernard-cluny-hora.latin: Hōra novissima, tempora pessima sunt — vigilēmus.

q-anselm-doce.ipa: /ˈdɔ.keː meː ˈkʷae̯.rɛ.rɛ teː ɛt ɔs.ˈtɛn.dɛ teː kʷae̯.ˈrɛn.tiː ˈkʷɪ.a nɛk ˈkʷae̯.rɛ.rɛ teː ˈpɔs.sʊm ˈnɪ.sɪ tuː ˈdɔ.kɛ.aːs nɛk ɪn.wɛ.ˈniː.rɛ ˈnɪ.sɪ teː ɔs.ˈtɛn.daːs/
q-anselm-doce.respelling: DO-kay may KWEYE-re-re tay et os-TEN-de tay kweye-REN-tee KWI-a nek KWEYE-re-re tay POS-sum NI-si too DO-ke-ahs nek in-we-NEE-re NI-si tay os-TEN-dahs
q-anselm-doce.latin: Docē mē quaerere tē et ostende tē quaerentī; quia nec quaerere tē possum, nisi tū doceās, nec invenīre, nisi tē ostendās.

q-aquinas-prima-via.ipa: /ˈpriː.ma ˈau̯.tɛm ɛt ma.nɪ.ˈfɛs.tɪ.ɔr ˈwɪ.a ɛst kʷae̯ ˈsuː.mɪ.tʊr ɛks ˈpar.tɛ ˈmoː.tuːs/
q-aquinas-prima-via.respelling: PREE-ma OW-tem et ma-ni-FES-ti-or WI-a est kweye SOO-mi-tur eks PAR-te MOH-toos
q-aquinas-prima-via.latin: Prīma autem et manifestior via est, quae sūmitur ex parte mōtūs.

q-dies-irae-quaerens.ipa: /ˈkʷae̯.reːns meː seː.ˈdɪs.tiː ˈlas.sʊs rɛ.deː.ˈmɪs.tiː ˈkrʊ.kɛm ˈpas.sʊs ˈtan.tʊs ˈla.bɔr noːn sɪt ˈkas.sʊs/
q-dies-irae-quaerens.respelling: KWEYE-rayns may say-DIS-tee LAS-sus re-day-MIS-tee KRU-kem PAS-sus TAN-tus LA-bor nohn sit KAS-sus
q-dies-irae-quaerens.latin: Quaerēns mē sēdistī lassus, redēmistī crucem passus; tantus labor nōn sit cassus.

q-angelus-conciperem.respelling: KWOH-mo-do kong-KI-pe-rem kweye WI-rum nohn kong-NOH-wee
q-angelus-conciperem.latin: Quōmodo conciperem quae virum nōn cognōvī?

q-adeste-cantet.ipa: /ˈkan.tɛt nʊŋk ˈiː.oː ˈkʰɔ.rʊs aŋ.gɛ.ˈloː.rʊm ˈkan.tɛt nʊŋk ˈau̯.la kae̯.ˈlɛs.tɪ.ʊm/
q-adeste-cantet.respelling: KAN-tet nungk EE-oh KO-rus ang-ge-LOH-rum KAN-tet nungk OW-la keye-LES-ti-um
q-adeste-cantet.latin: Cantet nunc īō chorus angelōrum; cantet nunc aula caelestium.

q-theodulf-gloria.ipa: /ˈgloː.rɪ.a lau̯s ɛt ˈhɔ.nɔr ˈtɪ.bɪ sɪt reːks ˈkʰriːs.tɛ rɛ.ˈdeːmp.tɔr/
q-theodulf-gloria.respelling: GLOH-ri-a lows et HO-nor TI-bi sit rayks KREES-te re-DAYMP-tor
q-theodulf-gloria.latin: Glōria, laus et honor tibi sit, rēx Chrīste redēmptor.

q-cb-veris-curramus.ipa: /ˈdzɛ.pʰʏ.rʊs nɛk.ˈta.rɛ.oː ˈspiː.raːns ɪn ɔ.ˈdoː.rɛ kɛr.ˈtaː.tɪm proː ˈbraː.wɪ.oː kʊr.ˈraː.mʊs ɪn a.ˈmoː.rɛ/
q-cb-veris-curramus.respelling: DZE-pü-rus nek-TA-re-oh SPEE-rahns in o-DOH-re ker-TAH-tim proh BRAH-wi-oh kur-RAH-mus in a-MOH-re
q-cb-veris-curramus.latin: Zephyrus nectareō spīrāns in odōre, certātim prō brāviō currāmus in amōre.

q-cb-in-trutina.ipa: /sɛd ˈeː.lɪ.goː kʷɔd ˈwɪ.dɛ.oː ˈkɔl.lʊm ˈjʊ.goː ˈprae̯.bɛ.oː/
q-cb-in-trutina.respelling: sed AY-li-goh kwod WI-de-oh KOL-lum YU-goh PREYE-be-oh
q-cb-in-trutina.latin: Sed ēligō quod videō, collum iugō praebeō.

q-einhard-equitando.ipa: /ɛk.sɛr.keː.ˈbaː.tʊr as.ˈsɪ.dʊ.eː ɛ.kʷɪ.ˈtan.doː ak weː.ˈnan.doː kʷɔd ˈɪl.liː gɛn.tiː.ˈlɪ.kɪ.ʊm ˈɛ.rat/
q-einhard-equitando.respelling: ek-ser-kay-BAH-tur as-SI-du-ay e-kwi-TAN-doh ak way-NAN-doh kwod IL-lee gen-tee-LI-ki-um E-rat
q-einhard-equitando.latin: Exercēbātur assiduē equitandō ac vēnandō; quod illī gentīlicium erat.

q-einhard-discenda.ipa: /ɪn dɪs.ˈkɛn.daː gram.ˈma.tɪ.kaː ˈpɛ.trʊm piː.ˈsaː.nʊm dɪ.ˈaː.kɔ.nɛm ˈsɛ.nɛm au̯.ˈdiː.wɪt/
q-einhard-discenda.respelling: in dis-KEN-dah gram-MA-ti-kah PE-trum pee-SAH-num di-AH-ko-nem SE-nem ow-DEE-wit
q-einhard-discenda.latin: In discendā grammaticā Petrum Pīsānum diāconem senem audīvit.

q-kempis-moriendum.ipa: /bɛ.ˈaː.tʊs kʷiː ˈhoː.ram ˈmɔr.tɪs ˈsʊ.ae̯ ˈsɛm.pɛr ˈan.tɛ ˈɔ.kʊ.loːs ˈha.bɛt ɛt ad mɔ.rɪ.ˈɛn.dʊm kɔ.ˈtiː.dɪ.eː seː dɪs.ˈpoː.nɪt/
q-kempis-moriendum.respelling: be-AH-tus kwee HOH-ram MOR-tis SU-eye SEM-per AN-te O-ku-lohs HA-bet et ad mo-ri-EN-dum ko-TEE-di-ay say dis-POH-nit
q-kempis-moriendum.latin: Beātus quī hōram mortis suae semper ante oculōs habet, et ad moriendum cotīdiē sē dispōnit.

q-magna-carta-ecclesia.ipa: /kʷɔd aŋ.glɪ.ˈkaː.na ɛk.ˈkleː.sɪ.a ˈliː.bɛ.ra sɪt ɛt ˈha.bɛ.at ˈjuː.ra ˈsʊ.a ˈɪn.tɛ.gra ɛt liː.bɛr.ˈtaː.teːs swaːs ɪl.ˈlae̯.saːs/
q-magna-carta-ecclesia.respelling: kwod ang-gli-KAH-na ek-KLAY-si-a LEE-be-ra sit et HA-be-at YOO-ra SU-a IN-te-gra et lee-ber-TAH-tays swahs il-LEYE-sahs
q-magna-carta-ecclesia.latin: … quod Anglicāna ecclēsia lībera sit, et habeat iūra sua integra, et lībertātēs suās illaesās.

q-asser-loquebatur.ipa: /ˈɛ.oː kʷɔd ʊt lɔ.kʷeː.ˈbaː.tʊr ˈɪl.loː ˈtɛm.pɔ.rɛ leːk.ˈtoː.reːs ˈbɔ.niː ɪn ˈtoː.toː ˈreːŋ.noː ɔk.kɪ.dɛn.ˈtaː.lɪ.ʊm ˈsak.sɔ.nʊm noːn ˈɛ.rant/
q-asser-loquebatur.respelling: E-oh kwod ut lo-kway-BAH-tur IL-loh TEM-po-re layk-TOH-rays BO-nee in TOH-toh RAYNG-noh ok-ki-den-TAH-li-um SAK-so-num nohn E-rant
q-asser-loquebatur.latin: … eō quod, ut loquēbātur, illō tempore lēctōrēs bonī in tōtō rēgnō Occidentālium Saxonum nōn erant.

q-oresme-subtilis.ipa: /hae̯k ˈau̯.tɛm ɪm.ˈprɛs.sɪ.oː ˈdeː.bɛt ˈɛs.sɛ sʊp.ˈtiː.lɪs ɛt ad ɛf.fɪ.gɪ.ˈɛn.dʊm seu̯ kɔn.tra.fa.kɪ.ˈɛn.dʊm dɪf.ˈfɪ.kɪ.lɪs/

q-oresme-subtilis.latin: … haec autem impressiō dēbet esse subtīlis, et ad effigiendum seu contrafaciendum difficilis.

q-petrarch-carpsi.ipa: /ˈwiː.tam ˈɛ.gɔ ˈtʊ.am ˈkarp.siː noːn ɪŋ.ˈgɛ.nɪ.ʊm au̯t ˈlɪŋ.gʷam ʊt kʷiː ˈɪl.lʊd ˈmiː.rɛr haŋk ˈstʊ.pɛ.am/

q-petrarch-carpsi.latin: Vītam ego tuam carpsī, nōn ingenium aut linguam, ut quī illud mīrer, hanc stupeam.

q-xii-legassit.ipa: /ˈʊ.tiː leː.ˈgaːs.sɪt ˈsʊ.pɛr pɛ.ˈkuː.nɪ.aː tuː.teː.ˈlaː.wɛ ˈsʊ.ae̯ ˈrɛ.iː ˈɪ.ta juːs ˈɛs.toː/
q-xii-legassit.respelling: U-tee lay-GAHS-sit SU-per pe-KOO-ni-ah too-tay-LAH-we SU-eye RE-ee I-ta yoos ES-toh
q-xii-legassit.latin: Utī lēgāssit super pecūniā tūtēlāve suae reī, ita iūs estō.

q-xii-calvitur.ipa: /siː ˈkal.wɪ.tʊr pɛ.ˈdɛm.wɛ ˈstrʊ.ɪt ˈma.nʊm ˈɛn.doː ˈja.kɪ.toː/
q-xii-calvitur.respelling: see KAL-wi-tur pe-DEM-we STRU-it MA-num EN-doh YA-ki-toh
q-xii-calvitur.latin: Sī calvitur pedemve struit, manum endō iacitō.

q-cicero-lex-loquens.ipa: /weː.ˈreː.kʷɛ ˈdiː.kiː ˈpɔ.tɛst ma.gɪs.ˈtraː.tʊm ˈɛs.sɛ ˈleː.gɛm lɔ.ˈkʷɛn.tɛm ˈleː.gɛm ˈau̯.tɛm ˈmuː.tʊm ma.gɪs.ˈtraː.tʊm/
q-cicero-lex-loquens.respelling: way-RAY-kwe DEE-kee PO-test ma-gis-TRAH-tum ES-se LAY-gem lo-KWEN-tem LAY-gem OW-tem MOO-tum ma-gis-TRAH-tum
q-cicero-lex-loquens.latin: Vērēque dīcī potest, magistrātum esse lēgem loquentem, lēgem autem mūtum magistrātum.

q-cicero-paruerit.ipa: /nam ɛt kʷiː ˈbɛ.nɛ ˈɪm.pɛ.rat paː.ˈrʊ.ɛ.rɪt a.lɪ.ˈkʷan.doː nɛ.ˈkɛs.sɛ ɛst/
q-cicero-paruerit.respelling: nam et kwee BE-ne IM-pe-rat pah-RU-e-rit a-li-KWAN-doh ne-KES-se est
q-cicero-paruerit.latin: Nam et quī bene imperat, pāruerit aliquandō necesse est.

q-dig-definitio.ipa: /ˈɔm.nɪs deː.fiː.ˈniː.tɪ.oː ɪn ˈjuː.rɛ kiː.ˈwiː.liː pɛ.riː.kʊ.ˈloː.sa ɛst ˈpa.rʊm ɛst ˈɛ.nɪm ʊt noːn sʊb.ˈwɛr.tiː ˈpɔs.sɛt/
q-dig-definitio.respelling: OM-nis day-fee-NEE-ti-oh in YOO-re kee-WEE-lee pe-ree-ku-LOH-sa est PA-rum est E-nim ut nohn sub-WER-tee POS-set
q-dig-definitio.latin: Omnis dēfīnītiō in iūre cīvīlī perīculōsa est: parum est enim, ut nōn subvertī posset.

q-dig-locupletiorem.ipa: /ˈjuː.rɛ naː.ˈtuː.rae̯ ˈae̯.kʷʊm ɛst ˈneː.mɪ.nɛm kʊm al.ˈtɛ.rɪ.ʊs deː.triː.ˈmɛn.toː ɛt ɪ.nɪ.ˈuː.rɪ.aː ˈfɪ.ɛ.riː lɔ.kʊ.pleː.tɪ.ˈoː.rɛm/
q-dig-locupletiorem.respelling: YOO-re nah-TOO-reye EYE-kwum est NAY-mi-nem kum al-TE-ri-us day-tree-MEN-toh et i-ni-OO-ri-ah FI-e-ree lo-ku-play-ti-OH-rem
q-dig-locupletiorem.latin: Iūre nātūrae aequum est nēminem cum alterius dētrīmentō et iniūriā fierī locuplētiōrem.

q-dig-desisse.ipa: /noːn ˈpɔ.tɛst wɪ.ˈdeː.riː deː.ˈsiːs.sɛ ha.ˈbeː.rɛ kʷiː ˈnʊm.kʷam ˈha.bʊ.ɪt/
q-dig-desisse.respelling: nohn PO-test wi-DAY-ree day-SEES-se ha-BAY-re kwee NUM-kwam HA-bu-it
q-dig-desisse.latin: Nōn potest vidērī dēsīsse habēre, quī numquam habuit.

q-dig-culpa.ipa: /kʷɔd kʷɪs ɛks ˈkʊl.paː ˈsʊ.aː ˈdam.nʊm ˈsɛn.tɪt noːn ɪn.tɛl.ˈlɛ.gɪ.tʊr ˈdam.nʊm sɛn.ˈtiː.rɛ/
q-dig-culpa.respelling: kwod kwis eks KUL-pah SU-ah DAM-num SEN-tit nohn in-tel-LE-gi-tur DAM-num sen-TEE-re
q-dig-culpa.latin: Quod quis ex culpā suā damnum sentit, nōn intellegitur damnum sentīre.

q-newton-hypotheses.ipa: /ra.tɪ.ˈoː.nɛm ˈweː.roː ˈhaː.rʊm gra.wɪ.ˈtaː.tɪs prɔ.prɪ.ɛ.ˈtaː.tʊm ɛks pʰae̯.ˈnɔ.mɛ.niːs ˈnoːn.dʊm ˈpɔ.tʊ.iː deː.ˈduː.kɛ.rɛ ɛt hʏ.ˈpɔ.tʰɛ.seːs noːn ˈfɪŋ.goː/
q-newton-hypotheses.respelling: ra-ti-OH-nem WAY-roh HAH-rum gra-wi-TAH-tis pro-pri-e-TAH-tum eks peye-NO-me-nees NOHN-dum PO-tu-ee day-DOO-ke-re et hü-PO-te-says nohn FING-goh
q-newton-hypotheses.latin: Ratiōnem vērō hārum gravitātis proprietātum ex phaenomenīs nōndum potuī dēdūcere, et hypothesēs nōn fingō.

q-newton-regula1.ipa: /ˈkau̯.saːs ˈreː.rʊm naː.tuː.ˈraː.lɪ.ʊm noːn ˈpluː.reːs ad.ˈmɪt.tiː deː.ˈbeː.rɛ kʷam kʷae̯ ɛt ˈweː.rae̯ sɪnt ɛt ɛ.ˈaː.rʊm pʰae̯.ˈnɔ.mɛ.niːs ɛk.splɪ.ˈkan.diːs sʊf.ˈfɪ.kɪ.ant/
q-newton-regula1.respelling: KOW-sahs RAY-rum nah-too-RAH-li-um nohn PLOO-rays ad-MIT-tee day-BAY-re kwam kweye et WAY-reye sint et e-AH-rum peye-NO-me-nees ek-spli-KAN-dees suf-FI-ki-ant
q-newton-regula1.latin: Causās rērum nātūrālium nōn plūrēs admittī dēbēre, quam quae et vērae sint et eārum phaenomenīs explicandīs sufficiant.

q-newton-lex3.ipa: /aːk.tɪ.ˈoː.niː kɔn.ˈtraː.rɪ.am ˈsɛm.pɛr ɛt ae̯.ˈkʷaː.lɛm ˈɛs.sɛ rɛ.aːk.tɪ.ˈoː.nɛm/
q-newton-lex3.respelling: ahk-ti-OH-nee kon-TRAH-ri-am SEM-per et eye-KWAH-lem ES-se re-ahk-ti-OH-nem
q-newton-lex3.latin: Āctiōnī contrāriam semper et aequālem esse reāctiōnem.

q-descartes-archimedes.ipa: /ˈnɪ.hɪl ˈnɪ.sɪ ˈpuːŋk.tʊm pɛ.ˈteː.bat ar.kʰɪ.ˈmeː.deːs kʷɔd ˈɛs.sɛt ˈfiːr.mʊm ɛt ɪm.ˈmoː.bɪ.lɛ ʊt ˈɪn.tɛ.gram ˈtɛr.ram ˈlɔ.koː diː.mɔ.ˈweː.rɛt/

q-descartes-archimedes.latin: Nihil nisi pūnctum petēbat Archimēdēs, quod esset fīrmum et immōbile, ut integram terram locō dīmovēret.

q-descartes-animadverti.ipa: /a.nɪ.mad.ˈwɛr.tiː jam ˈan.tɛ ˈa.lɪ.kʷɔt ˈan.noːs kʷam ˈmʊl.ta ɪ.nɛ.ˈʊn.tɛ ae̯.ˈtaː.tɛ ˈfal.sa proː ˈweː.riːs ad.ˈmiː.sɛ.rɪm/
q-descartes-animadverti.respelling: a-ni-mad-WER-tee yam AN-te A-li-kwot AN-nohs kwam MUL-ta i-ne-UN-te eye-TAH-te FAL-sa proh WAY-rees ad-MEE-se-rim
q-descartes-animadverti.latin: Animadvertī iam ante aliquot annōs quam multa, ineunte aetāte, falsa prō vērīs admīserim.

q-spinoza-homo-liber.ipa: /ˈhɔ.moː ˈliː.bɛr deː ˈnuːl.laː reː ˈmɪ.nʊs kʷam deː ˈmɔr.tɛ ˈkoː.gɪ.tat ɛt ˈɛj.jʊs sa.pɪ.ˈɛn.tɪ.a noːn ˈmɔr.tɪs sɛd ˈwiː.tae̯ mɛ.dɪ.ˈtaː.tɪ.oː ɛst/
q-spinoza-homo-liber.respelling: HO-moh LEE-ber day NOOL-lah ray MI-nus kwam day MOR-te KOH-gi-tat et AY-yus sa-pi-EN-ti-a nohn MOR-tis sed WEE-teye me-di-TAH-ti-oh est
q-spinoza-homo-liber.latin: Homō līber dē nūllā rē minus quam dē morte cōgitat, et ēius sapientia nōn mortis sed vītae meditātiō est.

q-luther-thesis27.ipa: /ˈhɔ.mɪ.nɛm ˈprae̯.dɪ.kant kʷiː ˈsta.tɪm ʊt ˈjak.tʊs ˈnʊm.mʊs ɪn ˈkɪs.tam tɪn.ˈnɪ.ɛ.rɪt eː.wɔ.ˈlaː.rɛ ˈdiː.kʊnt ˈa.nɪ.mam/
q-luther-thesis27.respelling: HO-mi-nem PREYE-di-kant kwee STA-tim ut YAK-tus NUM-mus in KIS-tam tin-NI-e-rit ay-wo-LAH-re DEE-kunt A-ni-mam
q-luther-thesis27.latin: Hominem praedicant, quī statim, ut iactus nummus in cistam tinnierit, ēvolāre dīcunt animam.

q-pico-superiora.ipa: /ˈpɔ.tɛ.rɪs ɪn iːn.fɛ.rɪ.ˈoː.ra kʷae̯ sʊnt ˈbrʊ.ta deː.gɛ.nɛ.ˈraː.rɛ ˈpɔ.tɛ.rɪs ɪn sʊ.pɛ.rɪ.ˈoː.ra kʷae̯ sʊnt diː.ˈwiː.na ɛks ˈtʊ.iː ˈa.nɪ.miː sɛn.ˈtɛn.tɪ.aː rɛ.gɛ.nɛ.ˈraː.riː/
q-pico-superiora.respelling: PO-te-ris in een-fe-ri-OH-ra kweye sunt BRU-ta day-ge-ne-RAH-re PO-te-ris in su-pe-ri-OH-ra kweye sunt dee-WEE-na eks TU-ee A-ni-mee sen-TEN-ti-ah re-ge-ne-RAH-ree
q-pico-superiora.latin: Poteris in īnferiōra quae sunt bruta dēgenerāre; poteris in superiōra quae sunt dīvīna ex tuī animī sententiā regenerārī.

q-erasmus-querela.ipa: /nam ʊt.ˈkʊm.kʷɛ a.ˈman.tɛm ab seː proː.ˈpɛl.lɛ.rɛ ɪn.huː.ˈmaː.nʊm ɛst ˈbɛ.nɛ mɛ.ˈrɛn.tɛm aː.wɛr.ˈsaː.riː ɪŋ.ˈgraː.tʊm pa.ˈrɛn.tɛm ak sɛr.waː.ˈtriː.kɛm ˈɔm.nɪ.ʊm aff.ˈliː.gɛ.rɛ ˈɪm.pɪ.ʊm/
q-erasmus-querela.respelling: nam ut-KUM-kwe a-MAN-tem ab say proh-PEL-le-re in-hoo-MAH-num est BE-ne me-REN-tem ah-wer-SAH-ree ing-GRAH-tum pa-REN-tem ak ser-wah-TREE-kem OM-ni-um aff-LEE-ge-re IM-pi-um
q-erasmus-querela.latin: Nam utcumque amantem ab sē prōpellere, inhūmānum est: bene merentem āversārī, ingrātum: parentem ac servātrīcem omnium afflīgere, impium.

q-erasmus-moriae.ipa: /ʊt.ˈkʊm.kʷɛ deː meː ˈwʊl.goː mɔr.ˈtaː.leːs lɔ.ˈkʷʊn.tʊr ˈnɛ.kʷɛ ˈɛ.nɪm sʊm ˈnɛs.kɪ.a kʷam ˈma.lɛ ˈau̯.dɪ.at stʊl.ˈtɪ.tɪ.a ˈɛ.tɪ.am ˈa.pʊd stʊl.ˈtɪs.sɪ.moːs/
q-erasmus-moriae.respelling: ut-KUM-kwe day may WUL-goh mor-TAH-lays lo-KWUN-tur NE-kwe E-nim sum NES-ki-a kwam MA-le OW-di-at stul-TI-ti-a E-ti-am A-pud stul-TIS-si-mohs
q-erasmus-moriae.latin: Utcumque dē mē vulgō mortālēs loquuntur — neque enim sum nescia, quam male audiat Stultitia etiam apud stultissimōs …

q-galileo-medicea.ipa: /kʷɔd siː ˈɪl.laːs ˈpriː.mʊs ɪn.daː.ˈgaː.wiː kʷɪs meː ˈjuː.rɛ rɛ.prɛ.ˈhɛn.dat siː ˈjiːs.dɛm ˈkʷɔ.kʷɛ ˈnoː.mɛn ɪm.pɔ.ˈsʊ.ɛ.roː ak mɛ.ˈdɪ.kɛ.a ˈsiː.dɛ.ra ap.pɛl.ˈlaː.roː/
q-galileo-medicea.respelling: kwod see IL-lahs PREE-mus in-dah-GAH-wee kwis may YOO-re re-pre-HEN-dat see YEES-dem KWO-kwe NOH-men im-po-SU-e-roh ak me-DI-ke-a SEE-de-ra ap-pel-LAH-roh
q-galileo-medicea.latin: Quod sī illās prīmus indāgāvī, quis mē iūre reprehendat, sī iīsdem quoque nōmen imposuerō, ac Medicea Sīdera appellārō?

q-melanchthon-duae-res.ipa: /ˈdʊ.ae̯ reːs sʊnt ˈkʷɪ.bʊs ˈnɪ.hɪl ˈmɛ.lɪ.ʊs ak diː.ˈwiː.nɪ.ʊs ˈha.bɛt huː.ˈmaː.na naː.ˈtuː.ra wɪ.ˈdeː.lɪ.kɛt ˈweː.rɪ.taːs ɛt juːs.ˈtɪ.tɪ.a/
q-melanchthon-duae-res.respelling: DU-eye rays sunt KWI-bus NI-hil ME-li-us ak dee-WEE-ni-us HA-bet hoo-MAH-na nah-TOO-ra wi-DAY-li-ket WAY-ri-tahs et yoos-TI-ti-a
q-melanchthon-duae-res.latin: Duae rēs sunt, quibus nihil melius ac dīvīnius habet hūmāna nātūra, vidēlicet vēritās et iūstitia.

q-caesar-gallia.ipa: /ˈgal.lɪ.a ɛst ˈɔm.nɪs diː.ˈwiː.sa ɪn ˈpar.teːs treːs/
q-caesar-gallia.respelling: GAL-li-a est OM-nis dee-WEE-sa in PAR-tays trays
q-caesar-gallia.latin: Gallia est omnis dīvīsa in partēs trēs.
